# GOATs — the greatest athletes of all time in every sport

> Complete list of the 322 sports on https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/ with the GOAT, Legends, Stars, Other greats and Prospects, the reasoning behind each pick, the fact-check level and the sources. Updated 2026-11-14. Countries in brackets (ISO codes). Sports involving animal exploitation are excluded. License: CC BY 4.0 — credit "GOATs, by Julio Cesar Prava (goat.biblioverse.org)".

## Team sports

### Women’s 3x3 Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-3x3-feminino
- Legends: Laëtitia Guapo (FR), Wang Lili (CN), Rae Lin D’Alie (IT)
- Stars: Cameron Brink (US), Jiang Jiayin (CN)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: 3x3 is young and no player dominates its history. Laëtitia Guapo and Wang Lili were Women’s Series MVPs, Rae Lin D’Alie was MVP of the 2018 World Cup and Cameron Brink of the 2023 World Cup. At the Olympics, the US won at Tokyo 2020 and Germany at Paris 2024.

Sources:
- [FIBA — MVP Brink no Mundial de 2023](https://fiba3x3.com/2023/worldcup/news/mvp-brink-stars-on-fiba-3x3-world-cup-2023-women-s-team-of-the-tournament)
- [FIBA — Wang MVP da Women’s Series 2023](https://www.fiba.basketball/en/news/wang-named-fiba-3x3-women-s-series-2023-mvp)

### Men’s 3x3 Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-3x3-masculino
- GOAT: Dušan Domović Bulut (RS)
- Legends: Dejan Majstorović (RS), Strahinja Stojačić (RS)
- Fact-check: low

Dušan Domović Bulut is regarded as the greatest 3x3 player in the world, with World Cup and World Tour titles and several MVP awards for Serbia.

Sources:
- [FIBA](https://fiba.basketball/en/news/3x3-mens-players-who-defined-2024)
- [Get Basketball](https://get.basketball/?p=2719)

### Women’s American Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-americano-feminino
- GOAT: Allison Cahill (US)
- Legends: Chante Bonds (US), Kim Grodus (US), Linda Jefferson (US)
- Stars: Chantel Wiggins (US), Jackie Radford (US), Marcelina Chavez (US), Jesse Felker (US)
- Other greats: Adrienne Smith (US), Liz Sowers (US), Sami Grisafe (US), Patricia Palinkas (US), Katie Hnida (US), Jen Welter (US), Kristy Moran (AU), Julie Harshbarger (US)
- Fact-check: high

Allison Cahill is considered the best women’s American football player in the world. She is a seven-time national champion, five-time league MVP, 14-time All-Star and the only quarterback to reach 100 career wins playing exclusively in women’s leagues, with more than 25,000 passing yards and over 350 passing touchdowns.

Sources:
- [Wfa pro mvp jersey and game ball displayed at pro football hall of…](https://wfaprofootball.com/wfa-pro-mvp-jersey-and-game-ball-displayed-at-pro-football-hall-of-fame/)
- [Wfa 2019 mvps 2](https://wfaprofootball.com/wfa-2019-mvps-2/)
- [2022 mvps](https://wfaprofootball.com/2022-mvps/)
- [2024 mvps](https://wfaprofootball.com/2024-mvps/)
- [Wikipédia (EN): List of female gridiron football players](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_female_gridiron_football_players)

### Men’s American Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-americano-masculino
- GOAT: Tom Brady (US)
- Legends: Joe Montana (US), Patrick Mahomes (US)
- Stars: Aaron Rodgers (US), Drew Brees (US), Peyton Manning (US), Jerry Rice (US), Lawrence Taylor (US), Jim Brown (US), Walter Payton (US)
- Other greats: Brett Favre (US), Dan Marino (US), Deion Sanders (US), Reggie White (US), Tyreek Hill (US)
- Fact-check: high

Tom Brady is the most successful champion in NFL history: he won seven Super Bowls — more than any franchise — and was a five-time Super Bowl MVP and a three-time league MVP. He holds the records for passing touchdowns, passing yards and playoff wins over 23 seasons.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): NFL Top 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NFL_Top_100)
- [Wikipédia (EN): The Top 100: NFL's Greatest Players](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Top_100:_NFL%27s_Greatest_Players)
- [Wikipédia (EN): IFAF World Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IFAF_World_Championship)

### Women’s Australian Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-australiano-feminino
- GOAT: Erin Phillips (AU)
- Legends: Daisy Pearce (AU), Jasmine Garner (AU)
- Stars: Tayla Harris (AU)
- Other greats: Heather Anderson (AU), Cora Staunton (IE), Brooke Walker (NZ), Chelsea Randall (AU), Darcy Vescio (AU), Brianna Davey (AU)
- Fact-check: high

Erin Phillips is widely considered the GOAT of women’s Australian football for her impact on and off the field. She is a two-time AFL Women’s (AFLW) premiership player and won the league best-and-fairest medal, playing a key role in growing the women’s game.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): AFL Players Association awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AFL_Players_Association_awards)
- [Wikipédia (EN): List of AFL Women's best and fairest winners](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_AFL_Women%27s_best_and_fairest_winners)
- [Wikipédia (EN): AFL Women's goalkicking records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AFL_Women%27s_goalkicking_records)
- [Wikipédia (EN): AFL Women's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AFL_Women%27s)
- [Top aflw players](https://www.superprof.com.au/blog/top-aflw-players/)

### Men’s Australian Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-australiano-masculino
- GOAT: Gary Ablett Sr. (AU)
- Legends: Gary Ablett Jr. (AU), Leigh Matthews (AU)
- Stars: Tony Lockett (AU), Wayne Carey (AU), Dustin Martin (AU), Marcus Bontempelli (AU)
- Other greats: Lance Franklin (AU), Robert Harvey (AU), Michael Voss (AU), Kevin Bartlett (AU), Jason Dunstall (AU), Paul Kelly (AU), Greg Williams (AU), Chris Judd (AU), Nat Fyfe (AU)
- Fact-check: high

Known as “God”, Gary Ablett Sr. is widely considered the greatest Australian rules footballer of all time. He won three Coleman Medals and was inducted into the AFL Hall of Fame, capping an extraordinary career.

Sources:

### Women’s Baseball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/beisebol-feminino
- GOAT: Doris Sams (US)
- Legends: Ayami Sato (JP), Joanne Weaver (US), Jean Faut (US), Sophie Kurys (US)
- Stars: Betty Foss (US), Lois Florreich (US), Maxine Kline (US), Ruth Lessing (US)
- Other greats: Dottie Schroeder (US), Lizzie Murphy (US), Effa Manley (US), Connie Wisniewski (US), Mamie Johnson (US), Miu Shiraishi (JP), Julie Croteau (US), Dottie Wiltse Collins (US), Jackie Mitchell (US), June Peppas (US), Arleene Johnson (US), Pepper Paire (US), Dorothy Kamenshek (US), Joanne Winter (US), Dorothy Ferguson (US), Faye Dancer (US), Claire Schillace (US), Audrey Wagner (US), Alma Ziegler (US)
- Fact-check: high

Doris Sams is considered the greatest women’s baseball player for her all-round ability, one of the most talented players in the All-American Girls Professional Baseball League (AAGPBL). She was an excellent pitcher and hitter.

Sources:

### Men’s Baseball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/beisebol-masculino
- GOAT: Babe Ruth (US)
- Legends: Jackie Robinson (US), Daisuke Matsuzaka (JP), Barry Bonds (US), Shohei Ohtani (JP)
- Stars: Hank Aaron (US), Hank Greenberg (US), Cy Young (US), Hal Newhouser (US), Ichiro Suzuki (JP), Miguel Cabrera (VE), Albert Pujols (DO/US), Alex Rodriguez (US), Justin Verlander (US), Deacon McGuire (US), Ty Cobb (US), Jimmie Foxx (US), Joe DiMaggio (US), Stan Musial (US), Yogi Berra (US), Roy Campanella (US), Mickey Mantle (US), Mike Schmidt (US), Mike Trout (US), Frank Robinson (US), Nolan Ryan (US)
- Other greats: Aaron Judge (US), Pete Rose (US), Josh Gibson (US), Ted Williams (US), Willie Mays (US), Robinson Canó (DO), Javier Báez (PR), Marcus Stroman (US), Sam Crawford (US), Randy Johnson (US), Sandy Koufax (US), Robin Yount (US), Cal Ripken Jr. (US), Frank Thomas (US), Juan González (PR), Roger Clemens (US), Johnny Bench (US), Lou Gehrig (US), Mark McGwire (US), Rogers Hornsby (US), Ernie Banks (US), Clayton Kershaw (US)
- Fact-check: high

Babe Ruth is considered the greatest baseball player of all time for his combination of skills as both hitter and pitcher. His contribution to the sport’s growth in the US and his role in popularizing the home run made him a legendary figure, redefining the game in an era when the long ball was far less common than today.

Sources:

- [Wikipédia (EN): List of Major League Baseball career batting average leaders](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Major_League_Baseball_career_batting_average_leaders)

- [Wikipédia (EN): Major League Baseball All-Century Team](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Major_League_Baseball_All-Century_Team)

### Women’s Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-feminino
- GOAT: Diana Taurasi (US), A’ja Wilson (US)
- Legends: Sue Bird (US), Lisa Leslie (US), Tina Charles (US), Tina Thompson (US)
- Stars: Sheryl Swoopes (US), Tamika Catchings (US), Candace Parker (US), Lauren Jackson (US), Candice Dupree (US), Cappie Pondexter (US), Nneka Ogwumike (US), Sylvia Fowles (US), DeWanna Bonner (US), Cynthia Cooper (US)
- Other greats: Katie Smith (US), Seimone Augustus (US), Becky Hammon (US), Angel McCoughtry (US), Maya Moore (US), Swin Cash (US), Arike Ogunbowale (US), Janeth Arcain (BR), Emma Meesseman (BE)
- Prospects: Caitlin Clark (US)
- Fact-check: high

Diana Taurasi is widely seen as the greatest women’s basketball player of all time: she retired in 2025 as the WNBA’s all-time leading scorer, with 3 league titles and 6 straight Olympic gold medals. A’ja Wilson shares the top spot: in 2026 she became the first player with five WNBA MVP awards (three in a row) and has three titles, two Finals MVPs and two Olympic golds.

Sources:

- [Wikipédia (EN): WNBA Most Valuable Player Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WNBA_Most_Valuable_Player_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): The W25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_W25)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Best WNBA Player ESPY Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_WNBA_Player_ESPY_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): WNBA All-Star Game Most Valuable Player Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WNBA_All-Star_Game_Most_Valuable_Player_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): WNBA All-Decade Team](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WNBA_All-Decade_Team)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Basketball at the Summer Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basketball_at_the_Summer_Olympics)

### Men’s Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-masculino
- GOAT: Michael Jordan (US), LeBron James (US)
- Legends: Kobe Bryant (US), Bill Russell (US), Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (US)
- Stars: Magic Johnson (US), Wilt Chamberlain (US), Larry Bird (US), Nikola Jokić (RS), Moses Malone (US), Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (CA)
- Other greats: Tim Duncan (US), Giannis Antetokounmpo (GR), Stephen Curry (US), Kevin Durant (US), Karl Malone (US), Shaquille O’Neal (US), Dirk Nowitzki (DE), Steve Nash (CA), Bob Pettit (US), Oscar Schmidt (BR), Pau Gasol (ES), Victor Wembanyama (FR)
- Fact-check: high

Michael Jordan won six NBA titles without ever losing a Finals, with six Finals MVPs, five regular-season MVPs and ten scoring titles, and turned basketball into a global phenomenon. LeBron James is the NBA’s all-time leading scorer and also leads in minutes and games played: he has four titles with three franchises, four MVPs and is still active in his 24th season, averaging over 20 points for 23 straight years. In the current era, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was MVP in 2025 and 2026, and Nikola Jokić has three MVPs.

Sources:

### Women’s Beach Handball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/handebol-de-praia-feminino
- Legends: Juliana Oliveira (BR)
- Stars: Camila Souza (BR), Nathalie Sena (BR)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No individual consensus: Brazil has three women’s world titles (2006, 2012 and 2014), a Guinness record. Juliana Oliveira was named best player of the 2018 World Championship, and Camila Souza and Nathalie Sena lead today’s national team. Germany were the 2024 champions.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundiais de handebol de praia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IHF_Beach_Handball_World_Championships)
- [Guinness World Records — mais títulos mundiais (feminino)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/85015-most-wins-of-the-beach-handball-world-championships-female)
- [IHF — seleção brasileira indicada a melhor da história dos Jogos Mundiais](https://www.ihf.info/media-center/news/brazil-nominated-world-games-greatest-athlete-all-time)

### Men’s Beach Handball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/handebol-de-praia-masculino
- Legends: Bruno Oliveira (BR)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No individual consensus: Brazil is the powerhouse of beach handball, with five men’s world titles (2006, 2010, 2012, 2014 and 2018), a Guinness record. Bruno Oliveira was named best player of the 2018 World Championship. Croatia were the 2024 champions.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundiais de handebol de praia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IHF_Beach_Handball_World_Championships)
- [Guinness World Records — mais títulos mundiais (masculino)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/85013-most-wins-of-the-beach-handball-world-championships-male)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial masculino de 2018](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Men%27s_Beach_Handball_World_Championships)

- Stars: Marina Fedorova (RU), Carolina González (ES), Andrea Mirón (ES)
- Other greats: Bárbara Colodetti (BR), Grytsje Van den Berg (NL), Leticia Villar (HU), Adriana Manau (ES)
- Fact-check: high

Adriele Rocha is considered the best player in the world, with the most individual world-level awards.

### Men’s Beach Soccer
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-de-areia-masculino
- GOAT: João Madjer (PT/AO)
- Legends: Bruno Xavier (BR), Ozu Moreira (JP/BR)
- Stars: Rodrigo Soares (BR), Gabriele Gori (IT), Dejan Stanković (CH), Jordan Santos (PT)
- Other greats: Noël Ott (CH), Neném (BR), Eliott Mounoud (CH), Llorenç Gómez (ES), Elinton Andrade (BR), Bê Martins (PT), Buru (BR), Amarelle (ES), Alan Cavalcanti (PT), Júnior Negão (BR), Júnior (BR), Ilya Leonov (RU)
- Fact-check: high

João Madjer is considered the best beach soccer player in the world, by far the player with the most individual world-level awards, and has won three Beach Soccer World Cups. In 2018 the prestigious France Football magazine named him the best beach soccer player of all time.

### Women’s Beach Volleyball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/volei-de-praia-feminino
- GOAT: Misty May-Treanor (US)
- Legends: Kerri Walsh (US)
- Stars: Juliana Silva (BR), Duda Lisboa (BR), Ana Patrícia Ramos (BR), Jackie Silva (BR), Sandra Pires (BR), Natalie Cook (AU), Kerri Pottharst (AU), April Ross (US)
- Other greats: Shelda Bede (BR), Adriana Behar (BR), Larissa França (BR), Barbara Seixas (BR), Holly McPeak (US), Ana Paula Henkel (BR), Adriana Samuel (BR), Talita Antunes (BR), Laura Ludwig (DE), Kira Walkenhorst (DE), Mariafe Artacho del Solar (AU), Taliqua Clancy (AU)
- Fact-check: high

Considered the greatest beach volleyball player of all time, Misty May-Treanor won three straight Olympic golds (2004, 2008, 2012) with her partner Kerri Walsh. She revolutionized the defensive role in the sport and held absolute dominance for more than a decade.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (PT): Medalhistas olímpicos do voleibol de praia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medalhistas_ol%C3%ADmpicos_do_voleibol_de_praia)

- [Wikipédia (EN): FIVB Beach Volleyball World Championships](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIVB_Beach_Volleyball_World_Championships)
- [Wikipédia (EN): 2024 Volleyball World Beach Pro Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Volleyball_World_Beach_Pro_Tour)
- [Wikipédia (EN): FIVB Beach Volleyball World Tour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIVB_Beach_Volleyball_World_Tour)

### Men’s Beach Volleyball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/volei-de-praia-masculino
- GOAT: Emanuel Rego (BR)
- Legends: Ricardo Santos (BR), Alison Cerutti (BR), Sinjin Smith (US), Karch Kiraly (US), Anders Mol (NO), Christian Sørum (NO)
- Stars: Phil Dalhausser (US), Todd Rogers (US)
- Other greats: José Loiola (BR), Bruno Schmidt (BR), Evandro Oliveira (BR), André Stein (BR), David Åhman (SE), Jonatan Hellvig (SE)
- Fact-check: high

Emanuel Rego is considered the greatest beach volleyball player in history, having won every possible title in the sport. He won three Olympic medals, including gold at Athens 2004, and has the most World Tour titles in beach volleyball history, ahead of American Karch Kiraly.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (PT): Medalhistas olímpicos do voleibol de praia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medalhistas_ol%C3%ADmpicos_do_voleibol_de_praia)

### Women’s Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-feminino
- GOAT: Marta (BR)
- Legends: Mia Hamm (US), Aitana Bonmatí (ES), Birgit Prinz (DE), Christine Sinclair (CA), Alexia Putellas (ES)
- Stars: Michelle Akers (US), Homare Sawa (JP), Carli Lloyd (US), Abby Wambach (US)
- Other greats: Lucy Bronze (GB), Alexandra Popp (DE), Pernille Harder (DK), Vivianne Miedema (NL), Lieke Martens (NL), Ada Hegerberg (NO), Khadija Shaw (JM), Sam Kerr (AU), Mary Earps (GB), Heidi Mohr (DE), Carolina Morace (IT), Sissi (BR), Dzsenifer Marozsán (DE), Megan Rapinoe (US), Mariona Caldentey (ES), Ewa Pajor (PL)
- Prospects: Linda Caicedo (CO)
- Fact-check: high

Marta is widely considered the greatest female player of all time and tops the all-time rankings of ESPN and FourFourTwo: she was named FIFA World Player of the Year six times (2006–2010 and 2018), is Brazil’s all-time top scorer and holds the record of 17 World Cup goals, men and women combined. At 39, she came off the bench to score both of Brazil’s goals in the 2025 Copa América final and was named player of the tournament. Mia Hamm (two World Cups and two Olympic golds) and Birgit Prinz (three straight world player awards and two World Cups) dominated the early eras; Christine Sinclair is the all-time top international scorer, men and women combined, with 190 goals; and Aitana Bonmatí became in 2025 the first woman to win three Ballon d’Or awards, all in a row, after winning the 2023 World Cup with Spain. In 2026, Alexia Putellas matched that mark with her third Ballon d’Or.

### Men’s Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-masculino
- GOAT: Lionel Messi (AR), Pelé (BR)
- Legends: Cristiano Ronaldo (PT), Diego Maradona (AR), Ronaldo Fenômeno (BR), Johan Cruyff (NL), Zinédine Zidane (FR), Kylian Mbappé (FR)
- Stars: Lev Yashin (RU), Marco van Basten (NL), Michel Platini (FR), Alfredo Di Stéfano (AR), Ferenc Puskás (HU), Erling Haaland (NO)
- Other greats: Franz Beckenbauer (DE), Ronaldinho Gaúcho (BR), Romário (BR), George Best (GB), Robert Lewandowski (PL), Lothar Matthäus (DE), Garrincha (BR), Eusébio (PT), Bobby Charlton (GB), Paolo Maldini (IT), Rodri (ES), Neymar (BR), Harry Kane (GB)
- Prospects: Lamine Yamal (ES), Estêvão (BR)
- Fact-check: high

Alongside Pelé, Lionel Messi is considered the greatest of all time: he holds a record eight Ballon d’Or awards, four Champions League titles, won the 2022 World Cup and is Barcelona’s all-time top scorer. At the 2026 World Cup, aged 39, he led Argentina to another final, won the Silver Ball and broke records at his sixth World Cup: most matches, most minutes and most assists in the tournament’s history (passing Pelé), and became the oldest player to score a World Cup hat-trick. With 21 goals he passed Klose and Marta, but finished as the second-highest World Cup scorer ever, behind Mbappé (22). Pelé remains the other ultimate reference and the player who revolutionized football: he is the only three-time world champion (1958, 1962 and 1970), won the World Cup at 17 — the youngest ever to score in a final —, scored 1,279 goals in 1,363 games and 92 hat-tricks, records recognized by Guinness, and scored 643 goals for Santos. In October 2026, Harry Kane won the Ballon d’Or, the first Englishman to do so in 25 years.

### Women’s Ice Hockey
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/hoquei-no-gelo-feminino
- GOAT: Marie-Philip Poulin (CA)
- Legends: Jenni Hiirikoski (FI), Angela Ruggiero (US), Jayna Hefford (CA), Hayley Wickenheiser (CA), Hilary Knight (US)
- Stars: Dawn McGuire (CA), Riikka Nieminen (FI), Geraldine Heaney (CA), Jennifer Botterill (CA), Noora Räty (FI), Sami Jo Small (CA), Kim St-Pierre (CA), Brianna Decker (US), Mélodie Daoust (CA), Taylor Heise (US), Sarah Fillier (CA)
- Other greats: Amanda Conway (US), Cammi Granato (US), Cassie Campbell-Pascall (CA), Caroline Ouellette (CA), Ann-Sophie Bettez (CA)
- Fact-check: high

Marie-Philip Poulin, “Captain Clutch”, is the greatest women’s hockey player in history: she scored decisive goals in several Olympic finals, won five Olympic medals and, at Milan-Cortina 2026, became the all-time top scorer in Olympic hockey, men and women combined, with 20 goals.

### Men’s Ice Hockey
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/hoquei-no-gelo-masculino
- GOAT: Wayne Gretzky (CA)
- Legends: Gordie Howe (CA), Eddie Shore (CA), Alexander Ovechkin (RU)
- Stars: Seth Martin (CA), Howie Morenz (CA), Bobby Clarke (CA), Mario Lemieux (CA), Bobby Orr (CA), Connor McDavid (CA), Jiří Holeček (CZ), Vladislav Tretiak (RU), Nikolai Sologubov (RU), Valeri Vasiliev (RU), Viacheslav Fetisov (RU), Anatoli Firsov (RU)
- Other greats: Dominik Hašek (CZ), Tommy Salo (SE), Andrei Vasilevskiy (RU), Ivan Tregubov (RU), František Tikal (CZ), František Kučera (CZ), Vladimir Krutov (RU), Kevin Fiala (CH), Juho Olkinuora (FI), Patrik Laine (FI), Pekka Rinne (FI), Roman Josi (CH), Evgeni Malkin (RU), Viktor Fasth (SE), Dennis Endras (DE), Ilya Kovalchuk (RU), Dany Heatley (CA), Niklas Kronwall (SE), Mats Sundin (SE), Maurice Richard (CA), Sidney Crosby (CA)
- Fact-check: high

Wayne Gretzky, “The Great One”, is the greatest hockey player of all time and leads nearly every offensive NHL statistic, such as assists and points. In 2025 Alexander Ovechkin passed his 894 goals to become the league’s all-time leading goal scorer; with 929 goals, he has announced that 2026–27 will be his final season. At Milan-Cortina 2026, the US won its first Olympic gold since 1980.

### Men’s Kings League
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/kings-league-masculino
- GOAT: Kelvin Oliveira (BR)
- Stars: Lipão Pinheiro (BR)
- Fact-check: low

The Kings League, created by Gerard Piqué in 2022, is seven-a-side football with its own rules that became a social media phenomenon. Kelvin Oliveira is the format’s biggest name: he was top scorer and best player at the 2024 Kings World Cup, with G3X, and at the 2025 Kings World Cup Nations, won by Brazil — which won the Nations Cup again in 2026, with Lipão Pinheiro as top scorer.

### Women’s Netball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/netbol-feminino
- GOAT: Irene van Dyk (ZA/NZ)
- Legends: Margaret Caldow (AU), Liz Ellis (AU)
- Stars: Sharelle McMahon (AU), Maria Folau (NZ), Jhaniele Fowler (JM)
- Other greats: Laura Geitz (AU), Vicki Wilson (AU)
- Fact-check: medium

Irene van Dyk is the most-capped international player in history: she played five World Cups (two for South Africa and three for New Zealand), with a shooting percentage almost always above 90%.

- [Silver Ferns](https://www.silverferns.co.nz/silver-ferns/history/players/irene-van-dyk.html)

### Women’s Netball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/netball-feminino
- GOAT: Irene van Dyk (NZ)
- Legends: Liz Ellis (AU), Jhaniele Fowler-Nembhard (JM), Sharelle McMahon (AU)
- Stars: Laura Geitz (AU), Geva Mentor (GB), Maria Folau (NZ)
- Other greats: Helen Housby (GB), Courtney Bruce (AU)
- Fact-check: medium

There is no consensus, but Irene van Dyk is the most frequent pick as the greatest netball player in history: the goal shooter played for South Africa and then New Zealand, with whom she won the 2003 world title, and reached 217 international caps. Australian defender Liz Ellis tops CODE Sports’ greatest-of-all-time poll, and Jamaica’s Jhaniele Fowler-Nembhard, record holder for Player of the Year awards in Australia’s top league, is called the GOAT by her national federation. Australia won the 2023 World Cup against England (61–45) for their 12th world title.

Sources:
- [CODE Sports — o GOAT do netball](https://codesports.com.au/netball/the-netball-goat-part-ii-iconic-goal-keeper-liz-ellis-tops-shooting-legends-for-a-podium-place/news-story/4eb3cfe0f8379cbab7279de7a72500b6)
- [Topend Sports — maiores jogadoras de netball](https://www.topendsports.com/world/lists/greatest-all-time/netball.htm)
- [Jamaica Observer — Fowler, uma das maiores](https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/sports/jhaniele-fowler-one-of-the-greatest-netballers/)
- [Daily Maverick — Austrália conquista a 12ª Copa do Mundo](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2023-08-06-dominant-aussies-record-12th-netball-world-cup-championship-sa-finish-sixth.md)

Andrew Johns won three Dally M Medals and is called the greatest of all by many. Cameron Smith had the most prolific career in history, with a record 430 NRL games. Nathan Cleary steered Penrith to four straight premierships (2021–2024) and was twice named man of the match in the Grand Final.

### Women’s Rugby Union
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/rugby-feminino

- Fact-check: high

Portia Woodman is widely recognized as the greatest women’s rugby player in history, dominant in both sevens and fifteens: she was the first woman to score 200 and then 250 tries in the Sevens Series. In 2025 England won the World Cup at home, and Canada’s Sophie de Goede was named World Player of the Year.

Jonah Lomu is widely considered rugby’s GOAT for redefining the wing position with an unmatched mix of size, power and speed. He dominated the 1995 Rugby World Cup with legendary performances, popularized rugby around the world and brought an explosive new style that shaped the generations that followed.

### Men’s Ultimate Frisbee

- Legends: Brodie Smith (US)
- Fact-check: low

Beau Kittredge is considered one of the greatest ultimate players in history: he has six US club titles, seven world titles, five pro league (AUDL) titles and two MVP awards. Brodie Smith is the sport’s most famous player and one of the greatest in college history.

### Women’s Volleyball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/volei-feminino

- Fact-check: high

Regla Torres was named the “Best Player of the 20th Century” by the FIVB; a three-time Olympic champion, her dominance as a middle blocker revolutionized women’s volleyball. Mireya Luis is considered the best attacker in volleyball history and was essential to Cuba’s dominance in the 1990s.

### Men’s Volleyball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/volei-masculino
- GOAT: Giba (BR), Karch Kiraly (US)
- Legends: Lorenzo Bernardi (IT)
- Stars: Sergey Tetyukhin (UZ), Andrea Giani (IT), Ivan Miljkovic (RS), Osmany Juantorena (CU)
- Other greats: Ivan Zaytsev (IT), Matey Kaziyski (BG), Vladimir Grbić (RS), Maxim Mikhaylov (RU), Dante Amaral (BR), Luciano de Cecco (AR), Katsutoshi Nekoda (JP), Earvin N’Gapeth (FR), Wilfredo León (PL), Alessandro Michieletto (IT)
- Fact-check: high

Giba was the pillar of Brazil’s golden generation: Olympic champion and MVP at Athens 2004, three-time world champion and MVP of the 2006 World Championship, plus two Olympic silvers. Karch Kiraly is the only player to win Olympic gold in both indoor (1984 and 1988) and beach volleyball (1996), and was named by the FIVB the greatest player of the 20th century.

### Women’s Water Polo
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/polo-aquatico-feminino
- GOAT: Maggie Steffens (US)
- Legends: Brenda Villa (US), Bea Ortiz (ES)
- Stars: Tania Di Mario (IT)
- Other greats: Roser Tarragó (ES), Ashleigh Johnson (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Maggie Steffens is a three-time Olympic champion (2012, 2016 and 2020) and was named world’s best player three times by the international federation. At Paris 2024, Bea Ortiz’s Spain won its first Olympic gold, and the US missed the podium for the first time.

Sources:
- [SwimSwam — ouro da Espanha em Paris 2024](https://swimswam.com/paris-2024-croatia-and-spain-advance-to-mens-gold-medal-match-usa-to-play-for-bronze-2/)

### Men’s Water Polo
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/polo-aquatico-masculino
- GOAT: Dezső Gyarmati (HU)
- Legends: Filip Filipović (RS), Tibor Benedek (HU), Dušan Mandić (RS)
- Stars: Manuel Estiarte (ES), Aleksandar Šapić (RS), Tamás Kásás (HU)
- Other greats: Pietro Figlioli (IT)
- Fact-check: medium

Dezső Gyarmati won three Olympic golds and medals at five Olympics (1948–1964), and is widely considered the greatest water polo player in history. Dušan Mandić won three straight Olympic titles with Serbia (2016, 2020 and 2024), was MVP and top scorer in Paris and was named world’s best in 2024.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Dušan Mandić](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Du%C5%A1an_Mandi%C4%87)
- [Topend Sports](https://www.topendsports.com/events/summer/medal-tally/rankings-sports-water-polo.htm)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dezs%C5%91_Gyarmati)

### Women’s Badminton

- GOAT: Zhang Ning (CN)
- Legends: Carolina Marín (ES), Gao Ling (CN), Huang Yaqiong (CN), Chen Qingchen (CN), Tai Tzu-ying (TW)
- Stars: Susi Susanti (ID), Liliyana Natsir (ID), Wang Shixian (CN), Li Xuerui (CN), Ge Fei (CN), Gu Jun (CN), Jia Yifan (CN), Wang Yihan (CN), Saina Nehwal (IN), Xie Xingfang (CN), Nozomi Okuhara (JP), Leani Ratri Oktila (ID), An Seyoung (KR), Akane Yamaguchi (JP)
- Other greats: Ra Kyung-min (KR), Zhou Mi (HK), Wang Xiaoli (CN), Yu Yang (CN), Zhao Yunlei (CN), Misaki Matsutomo (JP), Ayaka Takahashi (JP), Chen Yufei (CN)
- Fact-check: high

Zhang Ning is the only two-time Olympic women’s singles champion in badminton (2004 and 2008), as well as a world champion, and dominated the sport for more than a decade. In the current era, An Se-young was Olympic champion at Paris 2024 and world champion in 2023 and 2026, and Akane Yamaguchi is a three-time world champion.

### Men’s Badminton
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/badminton-masculino
- GOAT: Lin Dan (CN)
- Legends: Lee Chong Wei (MY), Viktor Axelsen (DK), Park Joo-bong (KR)
- Stars: Kim Dong-moon (KR), Taufik Hidayat (ID), Chen Long (CN), Marcus Gideon (ID), Kevin Sukamuljo (ID), Cai Yun (CN), Fu Haifeng (CN), Zhang Nan (CN), Kento Momota (JP)
- Other greats: Joko Suprianto (ID), Seo Seung-jae (KR), Zhang Jun (CN), Lee Yang (TW), Wang Chi-lin (TW), Hendra Setiawan (ID), Daiki Kajiwara (JP), Tony Gunawan (ID), Rudy Hartono (ID), Prakash Padukone (IN), Peter Gade (DK), Candra Wijaya (ID), Shi Yuqi (CN)
- Fact-check: high

Lin Dan, “Super Dan”, won two Olympic golds (2008 and 2012) and five world titles, and was the first to win every major title in the sport — which is why he is considered the greatest in history. Viktor Axelsen is also a two-time Olympic champion (2020 and 2024), and Shi Yuqi was world champion and named player of the year in 2025.

### Women’s Table Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-de-mesa-feminino
- GOAT: Wang Nan (CN)
- Legends: Zhang Yining (CN), Deng Yaping (CN), Mária Mednyánszky (HU), Angelica Rozeanu (RO), Ding Ning (CN), Li Xiaoxia (CN), Anna Sipos (HU), Gizella Farkas (HU), Liu Shiwen (CN), Sun Yingsha (CN), Chen Meng (CN)
- Stars: Guo Yue (CN)
- Other greats: Qiao Hong (CN), Chen Jing (CN), Wang Manyu (CN), Li Ju (CN), Miu Hirano (JP), Kasumi Ishikawa (JP), Mima Ito (JP), Feng Tianwei (SG), Hina Hayata (JP)
- Prospects: Kuai Man (CN), Miwa Harimoto (JP)
- Fact-check: high

Wang Nan won four Olympic golds (2000, 2004 and 2008) and 15 world titles — three in singles, five in doubles, six in teams and one in mixed doubles — dominating women’s table tennis around the turn of the 2000s. At Paris 2024, Chen Meng won her second straight Olympic singles title, a feat previously achieved only by Deng Yaping and Zhang Yining. Sun Yingsha, back-to-back world singles champion (2023 and 2025), already has eight world titles. Among the prospects, Kuai Man won the 2025 world doubles title and Japan’s Miwa Harimoto won WTT Champions Yokohama in 2026.

### Men’s Table Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-de-mesa-masculino
- GOAT: Ma Long (CN)
- Legends: Jan-Ove Waldner (SE), Victor Barna (HU), Fan Zhendong (CN)
- Stars: Miklós Szabados (HU), Bohumil Váňa (CZ), Wang Liqin (CN), Ma Lin (CN), Xu Xin (CN), Wang Hao (CN), Ichiro Ogimura (JP), Zhang Jike (CN), Liu Guoliang (CN), Ivan Andreadis (CZ), Ferenc Sidó (HU), Timo Boll (DE), Hugo Calderano (BR), Wang Chuqin (CN)
- Other greats: Ryu Seung-min (KR), Vladimir Samsonov (BY), Dimitrij Ovtcharov (DE), Jun Mizutani (JP), Tomokazu Harimoto (JP), Truls Möregårdh (SE), Félix Lebrun (FR), Lin Shidong (CN)
- Fact-check: high

Ma Long is the most successful table tennis player in history: he has six Olympic golds — a Chinese record in any sport — including the singles titles in 2016 and 2020, and 14 world titles, completing the sport’s “Grand Slam”. Jan-Ove Waldner, “the Mozart of table tennis”, was the only non-Chinese player to dominate the sport for decades. The new generation has narrowed the gap to China: Wang Chuqin was world champion in 2025; Lin Shidong became, at 19, the youngest world No. 1 in history; Truls Möregårdh, silver medalist at Paris 2024, was the first non-Chinese player to win a Grand Smash and rose to world No. 2; Tomokazu Harimoto won the 2025 WTT Finals; Félix Lebrun, Olympic bronze medalist at 17, became European champion in 2026; and Hugo Calderano won the World Cup and silver at the 2025 World Championships.

### Women’s Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-feminino
- GOAT: Serena Williams (US)
- Legends: Margaret Court (AU), Steffi Graf (DE)
- Stars: Helen Wills Moody (US), Chris Evert (US), Martina Navratilova (CZ/US), Billie Jean King (US), Margaret Osborne duPont (US), Louise Brough Clapp (US), Pam Shriver (US), Iga Świątek (PL), Aryna Sabalenka (BY)
- Other greats: Maureen Connolly (US), Monica Seles (RS/US), Molla Bjurstedt Mallory (NO), Suzanne Lenglen (FR), Dorothea Lambert Chambers (GB), Maria Esther Bueno (BR), Evonne Goolagong (AU), Venus Williams (US), Justine Henin (BE), Natasha Zvereva (BY), Elizabeth Ryan (US), Gigi Fernández (PR), Doris Hart (US), Maria Sharapova (RU), Lindsay Davenport (US), Ashleigh Barty (AU), Simona Halep (RO), Arantxa Sánchez Vicario (ES), Molla Mallory (NO/US), Mary Joe Fernández (US), Elena Rybakina (KZ)
- Prospects: Coco Gauff (US), Linda Nosková (CZ), Mirra Andreeva (RU)
- Fact-check: high

Serena Williams is widely considered the greatest tennis player of all time: she dominated women’s tennis for two decades, with 23 Grand Slam singles titles, 14 in doubles and four Olympic golds. In the current era, Iga Świątek has six Slams (including Wimbledon 2025) and Aryna Sabalenka four. In 2026, Elena Rybakina won the Australian Open and the US Open to reach three Slams, while Mirra Andreeva won Roland Garros and Linda Nosková won Wimbledon, both claiming their first Grand Slam titles.

### Men’s Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-masculino
- GOAT: Roger Federer (CH), Novak Djokovic (RS), Rafael Nadal (ES)
- Legends: Pete Sampras (US), Rod Laver (AU), Roy Emerson (AU)
- Stars: Björn Borg (SE), Bill Tilden (US), Mike Bryan (US), Bob Bryan (US), Carlos Alcaraz (ES), Jannik Sinner (IT)
- Other greats: Ivan Lendl (CZ), Todd Woodbridge (AU), John Newcombe (AU), Fred Perry (GB), Ken Rosewall (AU), Jimmy Connors (US), Andre Agassi (US), John McEnroe (US), Lleyton Hewitt (AU), Stefan Edberg (SE), Jim Courier (US), Gustavo Kuerten (BR), Andy Murray (GB), Ilie Năstase (RO), Reginald Doherty (GB), Vincent Richards (US), Laurence Doherty (GB), Alexander Zverev (DE)
- Prospects: João Fonseca (BR)
- Fact-check: high

The “Big Three” took tennis to another level. Djokovic holds the records for Grand Slam titles (24) and weeks at No. 1. Nadal, the “King of Clay”, won Roland Garros 14 times and 22 Slams in total (he retired in 2024). Federer, with 20 Slams, redefined dominance of the tour with style and longevity. In the new generation, Carlos Alcaraz already has seven Slams and completed the career Grand Slam at the 2026 Australian Open — the youngest ever — beating Djokovic in the final; Jannik Sinner has five, including Wimbledon 2025 and 2026. In 2026, Alexander Zverev won his first Grand Slam titles, at Roland Garros and the US Open.

## Athletics

### Women’s 3000 m Steeplechase
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/3000-m-com-obstaculos-feminino
- Legends: Beatrice Chepkoech (KE), Winfred Yavi (BH)
- Prospects: Faith Cherotich (KE)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: the women’s event only joined the World Championships in 2005. Beatrice Chepkoech holds the world record (8:44.32, 2018) and was 2019 world champion; Winfred Yavi, the second-fastest ever, was world champion in 2023 and Olympic champion at Paris 2024; and Kenya’s Faith Cherotich, 21, won the 2025 World Championships with a championship record.

Sources:
- [LetsRun — Cherotich campeã mundial em 2025](https://www.letsrun.com/news/2025/09/21-year-old-kenyan-wins-faith-cherotich-wins-steeplechase-world-title-in-championship-record-time-of-851-59/)
- [Wikipédia (EN): obstáculos femininos no Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Athletics_Championships_%E2%80%93_Women%27s_3000_metres_steeplechase)

### Men’s 3000 m Steeplechase
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/3000-m-com-obstaculos-masculino
- GOAT: Ezekiel Kemboi (KE)
- Legends: Soufiane El Bakkali (MA)
- Stars: Moses Kiptanui (KE), Lamecha Girma (ET)
- Other greats: Geordie Beamish (NZ)
- Fact-check: medium

Ezekiel Kemboi is the only athlete with four straight world steeplechase titles and one of three two-time Olympic champions (2004 and 2012). Soufiane El Bakkali is also a two-time Olympic (2021 and 2024) and two-time world champion; in 2025 he took silver behind New Zealand’s Geordie Beamish. Lamecha Girma holds the world record.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Ezekiel Kemboi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ezekiel_Kemboi)
- [Wikipédia (EN): obstáculos nos Mundiais](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steeplechase_at_the_World_Athletics_Championships)
- [LetsRun — Kemboi como o maior de todos](https://www.letsrun.com/?p=86984)

### Women’s 400 m
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/corrida-de-400-m-feminino
- GOAT: Marie-José Pérec (FR)
- Legends: Marita Koch (DE), Shaunae Miller-Uibo (BS)
- Stars: Marileidy Paulino (DO), Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Marie-José Pérec was a two-time Olympic 400 m champion (1992 and 1996) and in Atlanta also won the 200 m. Marita Koch has held the world record (47.60 s) since 1985, a mark surrounded by suspicion over doping in former East Germany. Shaunae Miller-Uibo was also a two-time Olympic champion (2016 and 2021). Marileidy Paulino won Paris 2024 with an Olympic record (48.17 s), and Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone was world champion in 2025 with a championship record (47.78 s).

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): 400 m feminino em Paris 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Athletics_at_the_2024_Summer_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women%27s_400_metres)

- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Athletics_Championships)

### Men’s 400 m
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/corrida-de-400-m-masculino
- GOAT: Michael Johnson (US)
- Legends: Wayde van Niekerk (ZA), Lee Evans (US)
- Stars: LaShawn Merritt (US), Kirani James (GD), Quincy Hall (US)
- Other greats: Collen Kebinatshipi (BW)
- Fact-check: medium

Michael Johnson is named the greatest 400 m runner in history for his unprecedented dominance of the event: he was a two-time Olympic champion (1996 and 2000), four-time world champion and the only man to win the 200 m and 400 m at the same Olympics (1996). Wayde van Niekerk took his world record in 2016 (43.03 s). Lee Evans was the first to run under 44 s, in 1968. Quincy Hall won Paris 2024, and Collen Kebinatshipi the 2025 World Championships.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): conquistas de Michael Johnson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_career_achievements_by_Michael_Johnson)
- [World Athletics — 400 metros](https://worldathletics.org/disciplines/track-running/400-metres)
- [Yahoo Sports — Quincy Hall campeão em Paris](https://ca.sports.yahoo.com/news/mens-400m-final-results-quincy-195520952.html)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Athletics_Championships)

### Men’s Decathlon
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/decatlo-masculino
- GOAT: Ashton Eaton (US)
- Legends: Daley Thompson (GB), Kevin Mayer (FR)
- Stars: Dan O’Brien (US), Roman Šebrle (CZ), Bob Mathias (US), Jim Thorpe (US)
- Other greats: Damian Warner (CA), Rafer Johnson (US), Leo Neugebauer (DE), Markus Rooth (NO)
- Fact-check: medium

Ashton Eaton is a two-time Olympic champion (2012 and 2016) and a two-time world champion, and was the decathlon world record holder. Daley Thompson also won two Olympics; Kevin Mayer holds the world record (9,126 points). Markus Rooth won Paris 2024, and Leo Neugebauer the 2025 World Championships.

Sources:

Sandra Perković is a two-time Olympic champion (2012 and 2016) and a two-time world champion, with a historic run of European titles. Valarie Allman is also a two-time Olympic champion (2021 and 2024) and won the 2025 World Championships.

Yuriy Sedykh has held the hammer throw world record (86.74 m) since 1986 and was a two-time Olympic champion. Paweł Fajdek has five world titles, and Ethan Katzberg is Olympic champion (2024) and a two-time world champion.

### Women’s Heptathlon

- Legends: Jessica Ennis-Hill (GB), Carolina Klüft (SE)
- Stars: Katarina Johnson-Thompson (GB), Sabine Braun (DE), Anna Hall (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Jackie Joyner-Kersee has held the heptathlon world record (7,291 points) since 1988 and was a two-time Olympic champion. Nafissatou Thiam achieved an unprecedented three straight Olympic titles (2016, 2020 and 2024). Anna Hall won the 2025 World Championships.

### Women’s High Jump
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/salto-em-altura-feminino
- GOAT: Stefka Kostadinova (BG), Yaroslava Mahuchikh (UA)
- Legends: Blanka Vlašić (HR)
- Fact-check: low

Stefka Kostadinova held the high jump world record (2.09 m) from 1987 to 2024, one of the longest-standing marks in athletics. Yaroslava Mahuchikh beat it with 2.10 m in 2024, the same year she became Olympic champion in Paris.

- GOAT: Mutaz Essa Barshim (QA)
- Legends: Javier Sotomayor (CU)
- Stars: Patrik Sjöberg (SE)
- Fact-check: low

Mutaz Essa Barshim is Olympic champion (Tokyo 2020) and a three-time world champion, the most consistent high jumper of the modern era. Javier Sotomayor still holds the world record (2.45 m).

### Women’s Hurdles
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/barreiras-feminino
- GOAT: Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone (US)
- Legends: Femke Bol (NL), Dalilah Muhammad (US)
- Stars: Sally Pearson (AU), Gail Devers (US), Kendra Harrison (US), Masai Russell (US)
- Other greats: Tobi Amusan (NG), Jasmine Camacho-Quinn (PR)
- Prospects: Ditaji Kambundji (CH), Jasmine Jones (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone is a two-time Olympic 400 m hurdles champion (2020 and 2024) and has broken the event’s world record several times, surpassing Edwin Moses’s historic marks in several respects; in 2025 she also won the flat 400 m at the World Championships with a championship record (47.78 s), and sat out 2026 to have her first daughter. Femke Bol was world 400 m hurdles champion in 2023 and 2025 and in 2026 moved up to the 800 m, taking European bronze. In the 100 m hurdles, Masai Russell, the 2024 Olympic champion, broke the world record in 2026 (12.09 s) and won the Ultimate Championship; Gail Devers has three world titles, and Switzerland’s Ditaji Kambundji was world champion in 2025.

Sources:

### Men’s Hurdles
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/barreiras-masculino
- GOAT: Edwin Moses (US)
- Legends: Karsten Warholm (NO), Grant Holloway (US)
- Stars: Colin Jackson (GB), Allen Johnson (US), Liu Xiang (CN), Rai Benjamin (US), Alison dos Santos (BR)
- Other greats: Roger Kingdom (US), Kevin Young (US), Félix Sánchez (DO), Aries Merritt (US)
- Prospects: Ja'Kobe Tharp (US), Cordell Tinch (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Edwin Moses won 107 straight 400 m hurdles finals over nearly a decade, was a two-time Olympic champion and broke the world record four times. In the 110 m, Grant Holloway won three straight world titles (2019, 2022 and 2023), Olympic gold at Paris 2024 and holds the 60 m hurdles world record; Allen Johnson has four world titles. In 2026, Alison dos Santos took the 400 m hurdles world record from Karsten Warholm (45.80 s) and won the Ultimate Championship, and Ja’Kobe Tharp, aged 20, broke the 110 m hurdles world record (12.75 s) and also won the Ultimate, ahead of 2025 world champion Cordell Tinch.

- [Athletics Weekly — recorde de Alison dos Santos](https://athleticsweekly.com/news/dos-santos-smashes-warholms-400m-hurdles-world-record-in-zurich-1040012802/)
- [LetsRun — recorde de Tharp](https://letsrun.com/news/2026/06/jakobe-tharp-stuns-track-world-and-himself-with-12-75-world-record-in-110m-hurdles)
- [World Athletics — Tharp vence o Ultimate Championship](https://worldathletics.org/competitions/world-athletics-ultimate-championship/2026/news/report/report-men-110m-hurdles-world-ultimate-championship-budapest-26)

Jan Železný is a three-time Olympic champion (1992, 1996 and 2000) and has held the javelin world record (98.48 m) since 1996. Neeraj Chopra was Olympic (2021) and world (2023) champion; Arshad Nadeem won Paris 2024 with an Olympic record.

### Women’s Long Jump
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/salto-em-distancia-feminino
- GOAT: Jackie Joyner-Kersee (US)
- Legends: Heike Drechsler (DE), Brittney Reese (US)
- Stars: Galina Chistyakova (RU), Malaika Mihambo (DE)
- Other greats: Tara Davis-Woodhall (US)
- Prospects: Agate de Sousa (PT)
- Fact-check: medium

Jackie Joyner-Kersee was Olympic (1988) and two-time world (1987 and 1991) long jump champion, as well as a two-time Olympic heptathlon champion, and is considered one of the greatest athletes in track and field history. Heike Drechsler was a two-time Olympic (1992 and 2000) and two-time world champion. Brittney Reese holds the record of four outdoor world titles, plus Olympic gold in 2012 and three Olympic medals. Galina Chistyakova has held the world record (7.52 m) since 1988. In the current era, Malaika Mihambo was Olympic champion (2021) and a two-time world champion; Tara Davis-Woodhall won Paris 2024 and the 2025 World Championships; and Portugal’s Agate de Sousa became world indoor champion in 2026.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Jackie Joyner-Kersee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackie_Joyner-Kersee)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Athletics_Championships)
- [World Athletics — final de Moscou 2013 e os títulos de Reese](https://worldathletics.org/competitions/world-athletics-championships/14th-iaaf-world-championships-7003368/news/report/report-womens-long-jump-final-moscow-2013)
- [Sportskeeda — as maiores medalhistas olímpicas da prova](https://www.sportskeeda.com/athletics/heike-drechsler-spearheads-list-of-most-successful-female-long-jumpers-summer-olympics)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial indoor de 2026 (feminino)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_World_Athletics_Indoor_Championships_%E2%80%93_Women%27s_long_jump)

### Men’s Long Jump
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/salto-em-distancia-masculino
- GOAT: Mike Powell (US), Carl Lewis (US)
- Legends: Bob Beamon (US), Miltiadis Tentoglou (GR)
- Stars: Iván Pedroso (CU)
- Other greats: Mattia Furlani (IT)
- Fact-check: medium

Mike Powell holds the long jump world record (8.95 m), set in his duel with Carl Lewis at the 1991 Tokyo World Championships and still standing more than three decades later. Carl Lewis shares the top spot: he won four straight Olympic long jump titles (1984, 1988, 1992 and 1996) and two world titles, went unbeaten for ten years (65 straight wins) and owns about a quarter of all jumps beyond 8.50 m in history. Bob Beamon jumped 8.90 m in 1968, a mark that stood for 23 years. Iván Pedroso was a four-time world champion and 2000 Olympic champion; Miltiadis Tentoglou is a two-time Olympic champion (2021 and 2024); and Italy’s Mattia Furlani became the youngest world champion in the event in 2025.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mike Powell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_Powell_(long_jumper))
- [Wikipédia (EN): Miltiadis Tentoglou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Miltiadis_Tentoglou)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Carl Lewis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carl_Lewis)
- [Wikipédia (EN): salto em distância no Mundial de 1991](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1991_World_Championships_in_Athletics_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_long_jump)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mattia Furlani](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mattia_Furlani)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial indoor de 2026 (masculino)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_World_Athletics_Indoor_Championships_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_long_jump)

### Women’s Long-Distance Running
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/corrida-de-fundo-feminino
- GOAT: Grete Waitz (NO)
- Legends: Tirunesh Dibaba (ET), Paula Radcliffe (GB), Faith Kipyegon (KE)
- Stars: Ingrid Kristiansen (NO), Sifan Hassan (NL), Beatrice Chebet (KE)
- Other greats: Catherine Ndereba (KE)
- Fact-check: low

Grete Waitz won the New York City Marathon nine times, was 1983 world marathon champion and broke the marathon world record four times, helping popularize women’s distance running. In the current era, Beatrice Chebet holds the 5,000 m and 10,000 m world records and won both events at Paris 2024 and at the 2025 World Championships.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Grete Waitz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grete_Waitz)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Beatrice Chebet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beatrice_Chebet)

### Men’s Long-Distance Running
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/corrida-de-fundo-masculino
- GOAT: Eliud Kipchoge (KE)
- Legends: Paavo Nurmi (FI), Haile Gebrselassie (ET)
- Stars: Kenenisa Bekele (ET), Emil Zátopek (CZ), Mo Farah (SO), Sabastian Sawe (KE)
- Other greats: Hicham El Guerrouj (MA), Joshua Cheptegei (UG), Kelvin Kiptum (KE)
- Fact-check: low

Eliud Kipchoge is a two-time Olympic marathon champion (2016 and 2020), was the first to run the distance in under two hours (1:59:40 at an unofficial event in 2019) and won the vast majority of marathons he raced over a decade. In April 2026, Sabastian Sawe ran 1:59:30 in London, the first official sub-two-hour marathon and the new world record.

Sources:
- [Al Jazeera — Sawe abaixo de 2 horas](https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/sports/2026/4/26/kenyas-sawe-is-worlds-first-man-to-run-a-sub-two-hour-marathon-in-london)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Eliud Kipchoge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge)

### Women’s Middle Distance (800 m & 1500 m)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/meio-fundo-800-m-e-1500-m-feminino
- GOAT: Faith Kipyegon (KE)
- Legends: Tatyana Kazankina (RU), Maria Mutola (MZ)
- Stars: Genzebe Dibaba (ET), Caster Semenya (ZA), Pamela Jelimo (KE), Kelly Holmes (GB), Keely Hodgkinson (GB)
- Other greats: Athing Mu (US), Jarmila Kratochvílová (CZ)
- Fact-check: medium

Faith Kipyegon is a three-time Olympic 1500 m champion (2016, 2020 and 2024), a four-time world champion in the event and the world record holder (3:48.68, 2025), dominating women’s middle distance for nearly a decade. Keely Hodgkinson was Olympic 800 m champion at Paris 2024.

- [Wikipédia (EN): Faith Kipyegon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Faith_Kipyegon)

### Men’s Middle Distance (800 m & 1500 m)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/meio-fundo-800-m-e-1500-m-masculino
- GOAT: Hicham El Guerrouj (MA)
- Legends: Sebastian Coe (GB), Jakob Ingebrigtsen (NO)
- Stars: David Rudisha (KE), Noureddine Morceli (DZ), Steve Ovett (GB), Kipchoge Keino (KE)
- Other greats: Wilson Kipketer (DK), Peter Snell (NZ), Said Aouita (MA), Emmanuel Wanyonyi (KE)
- Fact-check: medium

Hicham El Guerrouj has held the 1500 m (3:26.00) and mile (3:43.13) world records since 1998–99, was a four-time world 1500 m champion and completed the 1500 m/5000 m Olympic double at Athens 2004. Emmanuel Wanyonyi is Olympic (2024) and world (2025) 800 m champion.

Yelena Isinbayeva was a two-time Olympic champion (2004 and 2008), a three-time world champion and the first woman to clear 5 meters, breaking the world record 28 times.

Armand “Mondo” Duplantis is a two-time Olympic champion (2020 and 2024) and has broken the pole vault world record 15 times — the latest mark, 6.31 m, came in March 2026.

### Women’s Race Walking
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/marcha-atletica-feminino
- GOAT: Liu Hong (CN), María Pérez (ES)
- Stars: Kjersti Plätzer (NO), Olimpiada Ivanova (RU)
- Fact-check: low

Liu Hong is Olympic champion (2016) and a three-time world champion, and held the 20 km world record. María Pérez won the 20 km and 35 km at both the 2023 and 2025 World Championships, two doubles in a row.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/20_kilometres_race_walk)
- [Wikipédia (EN): María Pérez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mar%C3%ADa_P%C3%A9rez_(racewalker))

### Men’s Race Walking
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/marcha-atletica-masculino
- GOAT: Robert Korzeniowski (PL)
- Legends: Jefferson Pérez (EC), Volodymyr Holubnychy (UA)
- Stars: Álvaro Martín (ES), Massimo Stano (IT), Toshikazu Yamanishi (JP), Caio Bonfim (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Robert Korzeniowski won four Olympic golds and nine major titles, plus world records in the 50 km. Caio Bonfim was world 20 km champion in 2025, with silver in the 35 km.

Sources:
- [World Athletics](https://www.worldathletics.org/news/news/simply-the-best-korzeniowski)
- [IAAF](https://www.iaaf.org/news/news/what-makes-a-great-race-walker-a-look-at-some)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Athletics_Championships)

### Women’s Shot Put

- GOAT: Natalya Lisovskaya (RU)
- Legends: Valerie Adams (NZ)
- Other greats: Ilona Slupianek (DE)
- Fact-check: low

Natalya Lisovskaya has held the shot put world record (22.63 m) since 1987 and was Olympic champion in 1988. Valerie Adams is a two-time Olympic champion (2008 and 2012) and a four-time world champion.

- [Wikipédia (EN): Valerie Adams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valerie_Adams)

- Other greats: Joe Kovacs (US), Ulf Timmermann (DE), Adam Nelson (US)

### Women’s Sprinting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/corrida-de-velocidade-feminino

- Other greats: Grace Jackson (JM), Carmelita Jeter (US), Fanny Blankers-Koen (NL), Marita Koch (DE), Julien Alfred (LC), Melissa Jefferson-Wooden (US)
- Fact-check: high

Florence Griffith-Joyner, “Flo-Jo”, is considered the greatest female sprinter of all time, holding the 100 m (10.49 s) and 200 m (21.34 s) world records, both set in 1988 and still unbeaten. Her performance at the 1988 Seoul Olympics, with three golds and a silver, cemented her as a superstar.

Usain Bolt is considered the greatest sprinter of all time for his absolute dominance of the 100 and 200 meters: he has held both world records since 2009 (9.58 s and 19.19 s) and won eight Olympic golds and 11 world titles.

## Water sports

### Women’s Canoeing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/canoagem-feminino
- GOAT: Birgit Fischer (DE), Lisa Carrington (NZ)
- Legends: Danuta Kozák (HU)
- Fact-check: medium

Birgit Fischer won 8 Olympic golds over 24 years (1980–2004). Lisa Carrington matched the record at Paris 2024, where she won the K1, K2 and K4 500 m to also reach eight Olympic golds.

Sources:
- [Paddle Daily — Carrington iguala Fischer](https://paddledaily.com/2024/08/12/the-goat-strikes-again-womens-k1-olympics-recap/)

### Women’s Cliff Diving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/saltos-de-penhasco-feminino
- GOAT: Rhiannan Iffland (AU)
- Fact-check: low

Rhiannan Iffland has dominated women’s cliff diving for a decade: in 2026 she reached her tenth straight Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series title, had perfect seasons in 2019, 2021 and 2025, and beat Gary Hunt’s record of 47 wins in far fewer events.

Sources:
- [Red Bull — a década de domínio de Iffland](https://www.redbull.com/us-en/rhiannan-iffland-decade-of-cliff-diving-dominance)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull_Cliff_Diving_World_Series)

### Men’s Cliff Diving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/saltos-de-penhasco-masculino
- GOAT: Gary Hunt (GB/FR)
- Legends: Orlando Duque (CO)
- Fact-check: low

Gary Hunt is the most successful champion of the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series, with 11 titles and the men’s record for event wins; he left the circuit to compete in Olympic diving for France and returned in 2024. Colombia’s Orlando Duque was the sport’s first great name.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull_Cliff_Diving_World_Series)
- [Red Bull — recordes da World Series](https://www.redbull.com/us-en/cliff-diving-world-series-records-overview)

### Women’s Freediving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/apneia-feminino
- GOAT: Natalia Molchanova (RU)
- Legends: Alessia Zecchini (IT)
- Stars: Tanya Streeter (US), Alenka Artnik (SI)
- Other greats: Heike Schwerdtner (DE)
- Fact-check: medium

Natalia Molchanova broke 42 world records and won 19 of her 22 World Championship medals in gold; she was the first woman to pass 100 m in constant weight. In static apnea, Molchanova’s record (9 min 02 s, from 2013) stood for 11 years until it was beaten by Heike Schwerdtner, who reached 9 min 22 s in 2025 and 9 min 39 s at the 2026 World Championships, still pending ratification.

Sources:
- [SSI](https://www.divessi.com/en/blog/women-freedivers-2743)
- [AIDA — recorde de 9:22 de Schwerdtner homologado](https://www.aidainternational.org/PostDetails/573)
- [DeeperBlue — Schwerdtner no Mundial de 2026](https://www.deeperblue.com/world-apnea-2026-pool-championships-day-3/)

### Men’s Freediving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/apneia-masculino
- GOAT: Alexey Molchanov (RU)
- Legends: Herbert Nitsch (AT), William Trubridge (NZ)
- Stars: Umberto Pelizzari (IT), Jacques Mayol (FR), Enzo Maiorca (IT)
- Other greats: Stéphane Mifsud (FR), Branko Petrović (RS)
- Fact-check: medium

Alexey Molchanov has piled up world records and titles in several disciplines, including the constant weight with fins record (130 m). In static apnea — staying submerged for as long as possible without breathing — Stéphane Mifsud has held the AIDA-ratified record (11 min 35 s) since 2009 and was a five-time world champion; Branko Petrović has the best CMAS mark (10 min 45 s).

Sources:
- [Oyster Diving](https://oysterdiving.com/freediving-record/)
- [DeeperBlue](https://deeperblue.com/molchanov-zecchini-take-top-spots-at-molchanova-grand-prix)
- [Wikipédia (EN): apneia estática](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Static_apnea)
- [Guinness World Records — recorde de Mifsud](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/freediving-static-apnea-(men)-(breath-hold-duration))

### Women’s Kitesurfing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/kitesurf-feminino
- GOAT: Gisela Pulido (ES)
- Legends: Bruna Kajiya (BR)
- Stars: Ellie Aldridge (GB)
- Fact-check: low

Gisela Pulido became world champion at age 10 and piled up world titles, staying at the top for almost the entire history of the sport, which debuted at the Olympics in 2024 with gold for Ellie Aldridge, the first Olympic Formula Kite champion.

Sources:
- [Sailweb — resultados da vela em Paris 2024](https://sailweb.co.uk/2024/08/02/paris-2024-olympics-final-sailing-results-from-marseille)

- GOAT: Aaron Hadlow (GB)
- Stars: Kevin Langeree (NL), Valentin Bontus (AT)
- Fact-check: low

Aaron Hadlow is a five-time freestyle world champion and two-time King of the Air winner, the figure who defined modern kitesurfing. At the sport’s Olympic debut (Formula Kite, Paris 2024), the champion was Valentin Bontus.

### Women’s Open Water Swimming

- Other greats: Leonie Beck (DE), Judith de Nijs (NL), Gertrude Ederle (US), Alison Streeter (GB), Keri-Anne Payne (GB), Martina Grimaldi (IT), Ashley Twichell (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Ana Marcela Cunha is the most decorated athlete in open water World Championship history, with a record five 25 km titles, and was Olympic 10 km champion at Tokyo 2020. Sharon van Rouwendaal is the only woman to win two Olympic open water titles (2016 and 2024).

### Men’s Open Water Swimming
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/maratona-aquatica-masculino
- GOAT: Thomas Lurz (DE), Florian Wellbrock (DE)
- Legends: Yuri Kudinov (RU)
- Stars: Vladimir Dyatchin (RU), Gregorio Paltrinieri (IT), Spyridon Gianniotis (GR), Kristóf Rasovszky (HU)
- Other greats: David Meca (ES), Marc-Antoine Olivier (FR), Maarten van der Weijden (NL), Hector Pardoe (GB), Herman Willemse (NL), Jordan Wilimovsky (US), Axel Reymond (FR), Aleksey Akatyev (RU), Rob Muffels (DE), Yevgeny Bezruchenko (RU)
- Fact-check: medium

Thomas Lurz was one of the greatest open water world champions and won the 5 km and 10 km at the same World Championships (2009). Florian Wellbrock was Olympic 10 km champion at Tokyo 2020 and, at the 2025 World Championships, won the 10 km, the 5 km and the knockout sprint. Kristóf Rasovszky was Olympic champion at Paris 2024.

### Women’s Swimming
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/natacao-feminino
- GOAT: Katie Ledecky (US)
- Legends: Krisztina Egerszegi (HU)
- Stars: Sarah Sjöström (SE), Missy Franklin (US), Federica Pellegrini (IT), Summer McIntosh (CA)
- Other greats: Dara Torres (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Katie Ledecky has dominated distance freestyle for more than a decade: she has 9 Olympic golds (14 medals in total) and 23 world titles — a women’s record — was the first to win seven world titles in the same event (800 m freestyle) and holds the 800 m and 1500 m world records. Summer McIntosh, triple Olympic champion in 2024 and four-time gold medalist at the 2025 World Championships, is the great star of the new generation. In August 2026, McIntosh broke the 200 m butterfly world record (2:01.65) at the Pan Pacific Championships.

Sources:

- [CP24 — quarto ouro de McIntosh no Mundial](https://www.cp24.com/news/sports/2025/08/03/canadas-mcintosh-grabs-fourth-gold-to-cap-dominant-world-swimming-championships/)
- [SwimSwam — recordes do Pan-Pacífico 2026](https://swimswam.com/2026-pan-pacific-championships-records-roundup/)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Pan-Pacífico de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Pan_Pacific_Swimming_Championships)

### Men’s Swimming
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/natacao-masculino
- GOAT: Michael Phelps (US)
- Legends: Sun Yang (CN), Ryan Lochte (US)
- Stars: Ian Thorpe (AU), Caeleb Dressel (US), Mark Spitz (US), Léon Marchand (FR)
- Other greats: Murray Rose (AU), Grant Hackett (AU), Aaron Peirsol (US), Alexander Popov (RU), Tamás Darnyi (HU), Adam Peaty (GB), César Cielo (BR)
- Fact-check: high

Michael Phelps is considered the greatest swimmer in history and one of the greatest athletes ever: he holds the record of 23 Olympic golds (28 medals in total), 26 world titles and broke 39 world records, dominating butterfly, medley and freestyle for more than a decade. In the current era, Léon Marchand won four individual golds at Paris 2024 and in 2025 broke the 200 m medley world record Ryan Lochte had held since 2011.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (PT): Lista de medalhistas da natação no Campeonato Mundial de Esportes Aquáticos (masculino)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lista_de_medalhistas_da_nata%C3%A7%C3%A3o_no_Campeonato_Mundial_de_Esportes_Aqu%C3%A1ticos_(masculino))

- [ClickOnDetroit (AP) — recorde mundial de Marchand](https://www.clickondetroit.com/sports/2025/07/30/leon-marchand-breaks-world-record-in-200-individual-medley-in-1-minute-5261-seconds/)

### Women’s Windsurfing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/windsurf-feminino
- GOAT: Sarah-Quita Offringa (AW)
- Legends: Alessandra Sensini (IT)
- Fact-check: medium

Sarah-Quita Offringa of Aruba has 28 PWA world titles, the most in history among men and women. Alessandra Sensini won medals at four straight Olympics in windsurfing, with gold in 2000.

### Men’s Windsurfing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/windsurf-masculino
- GOAT: Robby Naish (US), Antoine Albeau (FR)
- Stars: Dorian van Rijsselberghe (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Robby Naish won every world title between 1983 and 1991, 24 in total, and is the face of the sport. Antoine Albeau reached 25 world titles over a 30-year career. Dorian van Rijsselberghe is a two-time Olympic champion (2012 and 2016).

Sources:

## Combat

### Women’s Boxing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/boxe-feminino
- GOAT: Katie Taylor (IE), Claressa Shields (US)
- Legends: Amanda Serrano (PR), Lucia Rijker (NL)
- Stars: Laila Ali (US)
- Other greats: Caroline Dubois (GB), Ann Wolfe (US), Cecilia Braekhus (NO), Holly Holm (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Katie Taylor was Olympic champion (2012) and ended her career in September 2026 by beating Flora Pili at Croke Park to become undisputed champion for the third time; promoter Eddie Hearn calls her the greatest female fighter of all time. Claressa Shields is a two-time Olympic champion and, by winning the heavyweight titles in 2025, became the first boxer of the four-belt era to be undisputed in three divisions. Amanda Serrano is the only woman with world titles in seven divisions.

Sources:
- [ESPN — despedida de Katie Taylor](https://www.espn.com/boxing/story/_/id/49838362/katie-taylor-beats-flora-pili-sign-illustrious-career-sold-croke-park)

### Men’s Boxing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/boxe-masculino
- GOAT: Muhammad Ali (US), Sugar Ray Robinson (US)
- Legends: Manny Pacquiao (PH), Oleksandr Usyk (UA), Terence Crawford (US), Floyd Mayweather Jr. (US), Joe Louis (US), Henry Armstrong (US), Naoya Inoue (JP)
- Stars: Tyson Fury (GB), Sugar Ray Leonard (US), Roberto Durán (PA)
- Other greats: Carlos Monzon (AR), Archie Moore (US), Julio Cesar Chavez (MX), Mike Tyson (US), Canelo Álvarez (MX), Rocky Marciano (US)
- Fact-check: high

Sugar Ray Robinson is the name experts most often pick as the greatest pound-for-pound boxer in history: he tops The Ring’s centennial list and the IBRO poll, with 174 wins. Muhammad Ali, three-time heavyweight world champion, is the public’s choice and the sport’s greatest icon. Joe Louis defended the heavyweight title 25 times, Henry Armstrong held three world titles at once, and Floyd Mayweather Jr. retired unbeaten (50-0), with titles in five divisions. In the recent era, Oleksandr Usyk was twice undisputed heavyweight champion, Terence Crawford retired unbeaten after unifying three divisions, Manny Pacquiao is the only world champion in eight divisions, and Naoya Inoue, unbeaten and undisputed in two divisions, is the pound-for-pound No. 1 in 2026.

Sources:
- [ESPN](https://africa.espn.com/boxing/story/_/id/47598558/men-boxing-pound-pound-rankings-new-king-no-1-familiar-face-returns-terence-crawford-retirement)

- [Wikipédia (EN): Usyk vs. Dubois II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oleksandr_Usyk_vs._Daniel_Dubois_II)
- [GMA — ranking histórico da The Ring](https://gmanetwork.com/news/sports/boxing/822296/the-ring-magazine-ranks-floyd-mayweather-above-manny-pacquiao-in-all-time-list/story)
- [IBRO — ranking peso por peso de todos os tempos](https://www.ibroresearch.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/01-IBRO-Pound-for-Pound-2019.pdf)
- [ESPN — os maiores peso por peso](https://www.espn.com/boxing/fnf/981202topten.html)
- [Yahoo Sports — ranking peso por peso de set. 2026](https://sports.yahoo.com/boxing/article/boxing-pound-for-pound-rankings-sept-2026-oleksandr-usyk-ousted-as-a-new-no-1-is-crowned-naoya-inoue-david-benavidez-shakur-stevenson-015406390.html)

### Women’s Fencing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esgrima-feminino
- GOAT: Valentina Vezzali (IT)
- Legends: Giovanna Trillini (IT), Ilona Elek (HU), Lee Kiefer (US)
- Stars: Mariel Zagunis (US), Laura Flessel (FR), Sofya Velikaya (RU)
- Other greats: Olga Kharlan (UA), Inna Deriglazova (RU)
- Fact-check: medium

Valentina Vezzali is the most successful fencer in history: six Olympic golds, including three straight individual foil titles (2000, 2004 and 2008). Lee Kiefer won back-to-back individual Olympic foil titles (2021 and 2024) and the team title in Paris.

### Men’s Fencing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esgrima-masculino
- GOAT: Edoardo Mangiarotti (IT), Aladár Gerevich (HU)
- Legends: Rudolf Kárpáti (HU), Áron Szilágyi (HU)

- Other greats: Daniele Garozzo (IT), Pál Kovács (HU), Cheung Ka Long (HK)
- Fact-check: medium

Edoardo Mangiarotti won 13 Olympic medals (6 gold) between 1936 and 1960 and 26 World Championship medals. Aladár Gerevich won 7 Olympic golds at six Games, from 1932 to 1960. At Paris 2024, Cheung Ka Long won his second straight Olympic foil title.

### Freestyle Wrestling (Freestyle)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/luta-livre-olimpica-feminino
- GOAT: Kaori Icho (JP)
- Legends: Saori Yoshida (JP)
- Stars: Helen Maroulis (US), Yui Susaki (JP), Akari Fujinami (JP)
- Other greats: Adeline Gray (US), Stanka Zlateva (BG)
- Fact-check: low

Kaori Icho was the first woman to win four straight Olympic golds in an individual event (2004–2016), plus 10 world titles. Saori Yoshida has three Olympic golds and 13 world titles. Akari Fujinami, Olympic champion at Paris 2024, went unbeaten for 155 straight bouts until 2026.

Sources:

Buvaisar Saitiev is a three-time Olympic champion (1996, 2004 and 2008) and six-time world champion; in 2007 the international federation named him, alongside Karelin, the greatest wrestler in history.

- Other greats: Gábor István (HU), Ryszard Wolny (PL)
- Fact-check: low

Aleksandr Karelin went 13 years unbeaten in international competition and won three Olympic golds. Mijaín López made history by winning five straight Olympic golds (2008–2024) in the same individual event, an unprecedented feat in Olympic sport.

Beatriz “Bia” Mesquita holds the record for IBJJF women’s black belt world titles, with 10 golds, and was ADCC champion in 2017. Gabi Pessanha dominates the heavyweights today, with a double gold at the 2024 World Championship.

Marcus “Buchecha” Almeida holds the record of 13 IBJJF black belt world titles, more than any other competitor, with an aggressive, adaptable style that redefined competitive jiu-jitsu. In no-gi, Gordon Ryan is the great reference, with ADCC titles in three weight classes.

### Women’s MMA
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/mma-feminino
- GOAT: Amanda Nunes (BR), Valentina Shevchenko (KG)
- Legends: Cris Cyborg (BR)
- Stars: Ronda Rousey (US), Rose Namajunas (US), Kayla Harrison (US), Weili Zhang (CN)
- Other greats: Joanna Jędrzejczyk (PL), Natalia Silva (BR)
- Fact-check: high

Amanda Nunes is the most common pick as the greatest female fighter in history: she was a simultaneous two-division UFC champion and beat Ronda Rousey, Cris Cyborg and Valentina Shevchenko (twice). Shevchenko dominated flyweight for years, regained the belt in 2024 and beat Zhang Weili in 2025, but vacated the title through injury in 2026. Cris Cyborg became in August 2026 the first woman to reach 30 MMA wins, with 19 world titles. Kayla Harrison, a two-time Olympic judo champion, has been bantamweight champion since 2025, and Brazil’s Natalia Silva won the flyweight belt in October 2026, on a 15-fight winning streak.

Sources:

### Men’s MMA
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/mma-masculino
- GOAT: Jon Jones (US)
- Legends: Fedor Emelianenko (RU), Khabib Nurmagomedov (RU), Anderson Silva (BR), Georges St-Pierre (CA), Islam Makhachev (RU), Demetrious Johnson (US)
- Stars: José Aldo (BR), Stipe Miocic (US), Israel Adesanya (NG), Alex Pereira (BR), Alexander Volkanovski (AU), Ilia Topuria (ES/GE)
- Other greats: Daniel Cormier (US), Kamaru Usman (NG), Justin Gaethje (US)
- Fact-check: high

Jon Jones tops most all-time MMA rankings: he was the youngest UFC champion ever, dominated light heavyweight for more than a decade, also won the heavyweight belt and never legitimately lost a fight; he announced his retirement in 2025 and has not fought again. Georges St-Pierre, Anderson Silva (16 straight UFC wins), Khabib Nurmagomedov (29-0, unbeaten) and Fedor Emelianenko complete the pantheon, alongside Demetrious Johnson, holder of the record of 11 straight title defenses. Islam Makhachev, a two-division champion, reached 17 straight wins in 2026, a UFC record. Ilia Topuria, also a two-division champion, suffered the first loss of his career when he lost the lightweight title to Justin Gaethje at the White House event in June 2026.

Sources:

### Men’s Arm Wrestling

- Other greats: Michael Todd (US)
- Fact-check: medium

John Brzenk dominated arm wrestling for three decades and is the name most often cited as the greatest in history. Levan Saginashvili is the dominant champion of the current era: he beat Devon Larratt 6–0 in 2022 and 4–0 in 2024.

Sources:
- [Fitness Volt — Saginashvili 4 a 0 em Larratt](https://fitnessvolt.com/2024-devon-larratt-vs-levan-saginashvili-results/)
- [Fitness Volt](https://fitnessvolt.com/armwrestling-champions/)
- [Wikipedia](https://wikipedia.com/wiki/John_Brzenk)

### Women’s Bodybuilding

- Fact-check: high

Iris Kyle is the most successful champion in professional bodybuilding history, men and women: she won Ms. Olympia ten times and Ms. International seven times. In the current era, Andrea Shaw won Ms. Olympia again in 2025 and is the division’s reference.

### Men’s Bodybuilding
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/fisiculturismo-masculino
- GOAT: Arnold Schwarzenegger (AT), Ronnie Coleman (US)
- Legends: Lee Haney (US), Phil Heath (US)
- Stars: Dorian Yates (GB), Flex Lewis (GB), Jay Cutler (US), Dexter Jackson (US), Chris Bumstead (CA), Steve Reeves (US), Derek Lunsford (US)
- Other greats: Flex Wheeler (US), Sergio Oliva (CU), Frank Zane (US), Franco Columbu (IT), Lou Ferrigno (US), Mamdouh Elssbiay (EG), Larry Scott (US), Breon Ansley (US), Shaun Clarida (US), Brandon Hendrickson (US), Edward Kawak (US), Eddy Ellwood (GB), Charles Clairmonte (BB), Kevin Levrone (US), Michal Krizanek (SK), Rich Gaspari (US), Hadi Choopan (IR), Samson Dauda (GB)
- Fact-check: high

Arnold Schwarzenegger is considered the biggest name in men’s bodybuilding history: he won Mr. Olympia seven times, redefined the ideal physique and brought the sport into the mainstream with the documentary Pumping Iron and his global fame. Ronnie Coleman won eight straight Mr. Olympia titles, tied with Lee Haney for the record, with a physique that revolutionized the sport. In the current era, Chris Bumstead won Classic Physique six times and Derek Lunsford regained Mr. Olympia in 2025.

- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: the women’s sport does not yet have a widely recognized dominant name. Natalya Rumyantseva holds the record of seven world titles (Guinness) and Kimberly Walford is a seven-time IPF world champion, the main federation.

Aneta Florczyk is considered the greatest strongwoman, one of the most successful competitors of all time. She won World’s Strongest Woman four times, a record that puts her at the top of the sport.

- Fact-check: high

Mariusz Pudzianowski is widely considered the GOAT of strongman: he won World’s Strongest Man five times, still a record, and later had an MMA career. In the current era, Tom Stoltman is a three-time champion and Mitchell Hooper won in 2023 and 2026.

### Women’s Weightlifting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/levantamento-de-peso-feminino
- GOAT: Li Wenwen (CN)
- Legends: Lidia Valentín (ES), Kuo Hsing-chun (TW), Rim Jong-sim (KP)
- Stars: Hou Zhihui (CN), Nurcan Taylan (TR), Meng Suping (CN), Zhou Lulu (CN)
- Other greats: Kim Un-ju (KP), Jiang Huihua (CN)
- Fact-check: medium

Li Wenwen is Olympic champion and holds the highest official total ever lifted by a woman (335 kg), as well as the super heavyweight snatch and clean & jerk world records. Tatiana Kashirina, previously listed as GOAT, was removed: the Court of Arbitration for Sport annulled her 2013–2017 results for doping and banned her for eight years.

Sources:
- [IWF — Li Wenwen e seus recordes mundiais](https://iwf.sport/2019/09/27/li-holds-three-world-records/)
- [NBC Sports — Kashirina punida por doping](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/tatiana-kashirina-doping-weightlifting-russia)

### Men’s Weightlifting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/levantamento-de-peso-masculino
- GOAT: Lasha Talakhadze (GE)
- Legends: Naim Süleymanoğlu (TR), Vasily Alekseyev (RU), Pyrros Dimas (GR), Leonid Taranenko (BY)
- Stars: Hossein Rezazadeh (IR), Halil Mutlu (TR), Yuri Vardanyan (AM)
- Other greats: Varazdat Lalayan (AM)
- Fact-check: medium

Lasha Talakhadze is the greatest weightlifter in history: at Paris 2024 he won his third straight Olympic gold (2016, 2020 and 2024), the first three-time super heavyweight champion, and holds the highest total ever recorded (477 kg). Naim Süleymanoğlu, Pyrros Dimas and Halil Mutlu were also three-time Olympic champions.

Sources:
- [BarBend — Talakhadze campeão em Paris 2024](https://barbend.com/news/lasha-talakhadze-wins-gold-medal-2024-olympics/)

Tia-Clair Toomey is the most successful champion in CrossFit Games history: she won six straight times (2017–2022) and, after a year away, came back to win in 2024 and 2025, reaching eight titles — the all-time record among men and women.

- Other greats: Solveig Løvseth (NO), Lisa Tertsch (DE), Taylor Knibb (US)

Daniela Ryf won the Ironman World Championship five times and holds records over the distance. Chrissie Wellington never lost an Ironman race. Paula Newby-Fraser has eight Kona titles. Cassandre Beaugrand was Olympic champion at Paris 2024, and Solveig Løvseth won the 2025 Ironman World Championship.

Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/triatlo-masculino
- GOAT: Jan Frodeno (DE), Alistair Brownlee (GB)
- Legends: Javier Gómez Noya (ES), Mark Allen (US), Dave Scott (US), Kristian Blummenfelt (NO)
- Stars: Alex Yee (GB), Simon Lessing (GB)
- Other greats: Craig Alexander (AU), Hayden Wilde (NZ), Casper Stornes (NO), Matt Hauser (AU)
- Fact-check: medium

Jan Frodeno was the first to win both Olympic gold and the Ironman World Championship (three times). Alistair Brownlee is the only two-time Olympic triathlon champion and holds the record for World Series wins. In the current era, Kristian Blummenfelt was Olympic (2020) and Ironman world champion, and Alex Yee won Olympic gold at Paris 2024.

### Women’s Ultrarunning & Trail

- Stars: Camille Herron (US), Katie Schide (US), Lizzy Hawker (GB), Blandine L’Hirondel (FR)
- Prospects: Jenn Lichter (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Courtney Dauwalter won Western States, Hardrock and UTMB in the same year (2023), with course records, and was named ultrarunner of the year five straight times. In 2026, Blandine L’Hirondel won UTMB with a record, and Jenn Lichter broke Dauwalter’s Western States record on her debut.

Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/ultramaratona-e-trail-masculino
- GOAT: Kilian Jornet (ES)

- Stars: François D’Haene (FR), Aleksandr Sorokin (LT), Vincent Bouillard (FR), Ben Dhiman (US)
- Other greats: Xavier Thévenard (FR), Pau Capell (ES)
- Fact-check: medium

Kilian Jornet is the first name in any debate about the greatest ultrarunner: he won UTMB three times, the Hardrock 100 repeatedly, and set ascent and descent records on mountains such as Everest. In 2026, Vincent Bouillard broke Walmsley’s Western States record and Ben Dhiman won UTMB in the fastest time ever.

### Women’s Archery
