- Stars: An San (KR), Lim Si-hyeon (KR)
- Fact-check: medium

Kim Soo-nyung won four Olympic golds and several world titles, leading South Korea’s dominance in archery. At Paris 2024, Lim Si-hyeon won all three possible golds (individual, team and mixed), and South Korea swept all five archery events.

### Bowling
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/boliche
- GOAT: Walter Ray Williams Jr. (US)
- Legends: Earl Anthony (US), Pete Weber (US), Norm Duke (US), Jason Belmonte (AU)
- Stars: Mark Roth (US)
- Other greats: Dick Weber (US), Mike Aulby (US), Don Carter (US), EJ Tackett (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Walter Ray Williams Jr. has the most titles in PBA Tour history (47) and was Player of the Year seven times. Jason Belmonte, who popularized the two-handed delivery, holds the record of 15 majors and also has seven Player of the Year awards.

### Button Football
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-de-botao
- Legends: Roberto “Robertinho” de Lara Rodrigues (BR), Mauro Cesar Michilin (BR)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: button football (table football played with discs) is a Brazilian passion split into several rule sets — 12 touches, 3 touches, “dadinho” and others — with no unified world championship. Under the 12-touch rules, Robertinho has six Brazilian titles and six Brazilian Cups, and Mauro Cesar Michilin was the first multiple Brazilian champion. In 2026, Nando Jesus won the 36th Brazilian Individual Championship under those rules.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (PT): campeões brasileiros de futebol de mesa (12 toques)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Campe%C3%B5es_brasileiros_de_futebol_de_mesa_(modalidade_bola_12_toques))
- [Mundo Botonista — estatísticas de jogadores](https://www.mundobotonista.com.br/players-stats)
- [NetVasco — Nando campeão brasileiro em 2026](https://www.netvasco.com.br/n/383312/futmesa-vascainos-nando-e-moacir-conquistam-os-titulos-brasileiros-adulto-e-master-da-regra-12-toques-em-campinas)

### Women’s Darts
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/dardos-feminino
- GOAT: Trina Gulliver (GB)
- Stars: Francis Hoenselaar (NL), Lisa Ashton (GB), Beau Greaves (GB)
- Other greats: Janine Gough (GB), Kimberley Lewis (GB), Fallon Sherrock (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Trina Gulliver won 10 women’s world titles and was the sport’s reference for two decades. Beau Greaves, a three-time women’s world champion, is the great name of the new generation and earned a PDC Tour Card.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): World Masters (darts)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Masters_(darts))
- [Sky Sports — Beau Greaves](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13465192/beau-greaves-wouldnt-say-no-to-premier-league-spot-as-womens-darts-star-prepares-for-grand-slam-appearance)

### Men’s Darts
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/dardos-masculino
- GOAT: Phil Taylor (GB)
- Legends: Michael van Gerwen (NL)
- Stars: Gary Anderson (GB), Luke Littler (GB)
- Other greats: Adrian Lewis (GB), Peter Wright (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Phil “The Power” Taylor won 16 world titles, a dominance unmatched in any individual sport. Michael van Gerwen is a three-time PDC world champion, and Luke Littler was world champion in 2025 and 2026 while still a teenager.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): PDC World Darts Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDC_World_Darts_Championship)

### Women’s Golf
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/golfe-feminino
- GOAT: Annika Sörenstam (SE)
- Legends: Lorena Ochoa (MX), Patty Berg (US), Mickey Wright (US), Kathy Whitworth (US)
- Stars: Lydia Ko (NZ), Inbee Park (KR), Nelly Korda (US)
- Other greats: Se Ri Pak (KR)
- Fact-check: medium

Annika Sörenstam won 10 majors and 72 LPGA Tour events and dominated women’s golf in the early 2000s. Kathy Whitworth holds the record of 88 LPGA Tour wins, Patty Berg the record of 15 majors, and Mickey Wright had 82 wins and 13 majors. In the recent era, Inbee Park has seven majors, Lydia Ko entered the Hall of Fame with her 2024 Olympic gold, and Nelly Korda won the Chevron Championship and the US Open in 2026, reaching four majors.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Best Female Golfer ESPY Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Best_Female_Golfer_ESPY_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Dinah Shore Trophy Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dinah_Shore_Trophy_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Edith Cummings Munson Golf Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edith_Cummings_Munson_Golf_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Heather Farr Player Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heather_Farr_Player_Award)
- [Wikipédia (EN): campeãs de majors do LPGA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chronological_list_of_LPGA_major_golf_champions)
- [AIG Women’s Open — campeãs de majors em 2026](https://www.aigwomensopen.com/news/2026/07/nelly-korda-haeran-ryu-major-winners)
- [Wikipédia (EN): US Women’s Open 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_U.S._Women%27s_Open)

### Men’s Golf
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/golfe-masculino
- GOAT: Tiger Woods (US)
- Legends: Jack Nicklaus (US), Arnold Palmer (US), Ben Hogan (US), Rory McIlroy (GB)
- Stars: Gary Player (ZA), Phil Mickelson (US), Scottie Scheffler (US), Bobby Jones (US), Sam Snead (US), Walter Hagen (US)
- Other greats: Seve Ballesteros (ES)
- Fact-check: high

Tiger Woods is named the greatest golfer in history: he has 15 majors, shares the record of 82 PGA Tour wins with Sam Snead and once held all four majors at the same time (2000–01). Jack Nicklaus holds the record of 18 majors and is the main rival in the debate. Rory McIlroy completed the career Grand Slam at the 2025 Masters and won it again in 2026, reaching six majors; Scottie Scheffler, with four majors, won the 2026 FedExCup. The other 2026 majors went to Aaron Rai, Wyndham Clark and Ryan Fox.

Sources:
- [NBC — majors de Rory McIlroy](https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/sports/golf/rory-mcilroy-major-championship-wins/)
- [Golf Monthly — majors de 2026](https://www.golfmonthly.com/news/mens-combined-major-leaderboard-2026)
- [Wikipédia (EN): campeões de majors masculinos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_men%27s_major_championships_winning_golfers)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Scottie Scheffler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scottie_Scheffler)
- [Sky Sports — calendário e campeões de 2026](https://www.skysports.com/golf/news/13415204/pga-tour-2026-schedule-dates-venues-events-for-the-new-fedexcup-season-signature-events-and-golf-majors)

### Women’s Pool
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/bilhar-pool-feminino
- GOAT: Allison Fisher (GB)
- Legends: Jeanette Lee (US), Ewa Mataya Laurance (SE)
- Stars: Kelly Fisher (GB), Karen Corr (GB), Ga Young Kim (KR), Jasmin Ouschan (AT)
- Other greats: LoreeJon Hasson (US), Monica Webb (US), Seo Seoa (KR), Kristina Tkach (RU)
- Fact-check: medium

England’s Allison Fisher, the “Duchess of Doom”, is considered the greatest female pool player in history: after winning multiple snooker world titles, she switched to 9-ball in the 1990s, won four World Championships (1996, 1997, 1998 and 2001), topped the WPBA rankings for five straight years and entered the Hall of Fame in 2009. In 2025, Korea’s Seo Seoa won the women’s 9-ball World Championship against Russia’s Kristina Tkach.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Allison Fisher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allison_Fisher)
- [Billiards Digest — Fisher no Hall da Fama](https://billiardsdigest.com/new_current_issue/oct_09/index_allison.php)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial feminino de 9-ball de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_WPA_Women%27s_World_Nine-ball_Championship)

### Men’s Pool
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/bilhar-pool-masculino
- GOAT: Efren “Bata” Reyes (PH)
- Legends: Earl Strickland (US), Shane Van Boening (US), Willie Mosconi (US)
- Stars: Fedor Gorst (US), Carlo Biado (PH)
- Other greats: Alex Pagulayan (CA), Nick Varner (US), Mike Sigel (US), Ralf Souquet (DE), Joshua Filler (DE)
- Fact-check: medium

The Philippines’ Efren “Bata” Reyes is widely considered the greatest pool player in history: he was the first to win WPA world titles in two different disciplines and comfortably leads polls of experts and fans, ahead of Earl Strickland and Shane Van Boening. Willie Mosconi dominated the straight pool era in the 1940s and 1950s. In the recent era, Fedor Gorst and Carlo Biado contested the 2025 World Championship final in Jeddah, and Biado became the first Filipino to win two 9-ball world titles.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Efren Reyes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Efren_Reyes)
- [AZBilliards — enquete de maiores de todos os tempos](https://forums.azbilliards.com/goto/post?id=6420090)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 9-ball de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_WPA_World_Nine-ball_Championship)
- [Context.ph — Biado bicampeão mundial](https://context.ph/2025/07/27/a-duel-of-destiny-carlo-biado-claims-2nd-world-poll-crown-in-jeddah-tourney/)

### Women’s Shooting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tiro-esportivo-feminino
- GOAT: Kim Rhode (US)
- Legends: Renata Mauer (PL)
- Stars: Guo Wenjun (CN), Maria Grozdeva (BG)
- Other greats: Diana Bacosi (IT), Zhang Shan (CN)
- Fact-check: high

Kim Rhode is one of the most consistent athletes in Olympic history, excelling in shotgun events, skeet and trap. She became the first US athlete to win medals at six consecutive Olympics (1996 to 2016), including three golds, a silver and two bronzes.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): List of Olympic medalists in shooting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Olympic_medalists_in_shooting)

### Men’s Shooting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tiro-esportivo-masculino
- GOAT: Jin Jong-oh (KR), Vincent Hancock (US)
- Legends: Karl Zimmermann (CH), Rajmond Debevec (SI), Ralf Schumann (DE), Konrad Staeheli (CH), Károly Takács (HU)
- Stars: Josias Hartmann (CH), Emil Kellenberger (CH), Łukasz Czapla (PL), Torsten Ullman (SE), Paul Van Asbroeck (BE), Emil Martinsson (SE), Walter Stokes (US), Gary Anderson (GB), Lones Wigger (US), Kullervo Leskinen (FI), Wilhelm Schnyder (CH), John Robert Foster (US), Gennadi Lushikov (RU), Lubos Racansky (CZ), Louis Richardet (CH), Moysey Itkis (RU), Walter Lienhard (CH), Otto Horber (CH), Józef Zapędzki (PL), Vilhelm Carlberg (SE), Wang Yifu (CN), Niccolò Campriani (IT), Matt Emmons (US), Malcolm Cooper (GB), Luciano Giovannetti (IT), Yang Ling (CN)
- Other greats: Michael Diamond (AU), Alfred Swahn (SE), Ole Lilloe-Olsen (NO)
- Fact-check: high

Jin Jong-oh is the only shooter with four individual Olympic titles and the only one to win the same event three straight times (50 m pistol). At Paris 2024, Vincent Hancock became the first to win four golds in the same individual event, skeet. Among historic references, Konrad Staeheli dominated the early 20th century and Károly Takács was a two-time Olympic champion shooting left-handed after losing his right hand.

Sources:

### Women’s Snooker
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/sinuca-snooker-feminino
- GOAT: Reanne Evans (GB)
- Legends: Allison Fisher (GB), Ruth Harrison (GB)
- Stars: Kelly Fisher (GB), Karen Corr (GB), Ng On Yee (HK), Emma Bonney (GB), Joyce Gardner (GB), Bai Yulu (CN)
- Other greats: Vera Selby (GB), Maureen Baynton (GB), Mink Nutcharut (TH)
- Fact-check: medium

Reanne Evans is the most successful champion in women’s snooker history: she holds the record of 12 world titles — ten in a row, from 2005 to 2014 — and has never lost a World Championship final. Allison Fisher, before becoming the greatest female pool player, was also a multiple snooker world champion. In the recent era, China’s Bai Yulu won the 2025 World Championship against Thailand’s Mink Nutcharut, and Hong Kong’s Ng On Yee is a three-time world champion.

### Men’s Snooker
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/sinuca-snooker-masculino
- GOAT: Ronnie O’Sullivan (GB)
- Legends: Stephen Hendry (GB)
- Stars: Mark Selby (GB), Zhao Xintong (CN), Wu Yize (CN)
- Other greats: John Higgins (GB), Shaun Murphy (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Ronnie O’Sullivan has 7 snooker world titles and the records for maximum breaks (147) and ranking titles. Stephen Hendry also won seven World Championships. In 2025 Zhao Xintong became the first Chinese world champion, and in 2026 Wu Yize, aged 22, beat Shaun Murphy 18–17 in the Crucible final to become the second-youngest champion in history.

Sources:
- [Sky Sports — Wu Yize campeão mundial de 2026](https://www.skysports.com/more-sports/snooker/news/29876/13540204/wu-yize-wins-2026-world-snooker-championship-as-he-beats-shaun-murphy-in-final-frame-epic-at-crucible)

### Table Football (Foosball)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/pebolim
- GOAT: Frédéric Collignon (BE)
- Legends: Todd Loffredo (US)
- Stars: Tony Spredeman (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Frédéric Collignon has more world titles on more tables than any other player: he won the ITSF multi-table World Championship seven times and the Tornado World Championship five times between 1997 and 2012, and was the only European to also dominate in the US. Collignon himself names his doubles partner, Todd Loffredo, as the greatest of all. Tony Spredeman is one of the leading names of the current era.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Frédéric Collignon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fr%C3%A9d%C3%A9ric_Collignon)

## Acrobatics & art

### Women’s Artistic Gymnastics
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/ginastica-artistica-feminino
- GOAT: Simone Biles (US)
- Legends: Nadia Comaneci (RO), Larisa Latynina (UA)
- Stars: Svetlana Khorkina (RU), Shannon Miller (US), Rebeca Andrade (BR)
- Other greats: Oksana Chusovitina (UZ), Aliya Mustafina (RU), Skye Blakely (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Simone Biles is widely considered the greatest gymnast in history: she has 11 Olympic medals (7 gold) — three golds and a silver at Paris 2024 — 30 World Championship medals and five skills named after her. Larisa Latynina, with 18 Olympic medals, remains an absolute legend. Brazil’s Rebeca Andrade, with six Olympic medals, beat Biles on floor in Paris. At the 2026 World Championships in Rotterdam, American Skye Blakely won the all-around title.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): List of multiple Olympic medalists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_multiple_Olympic_medalists)
- [NBC Sports — resultados do Mundial de 2026](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/gymnastics-world-championships-results-2026)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Simone Biles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simone_Biles)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Rebeca Andrade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebeca_Andrade)

### Men’s Artistic Gymnastics
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/ginastica-artistica-masculino
- GOAT: Nikolai Andrianov (RU), Kohei Uchimura (JP)
- Legends: Vitaly Scherbo (BY), Boris Shakhlin (RU), Takashi Ono (JP), Daiki Hashimoto (JP)
- Stars: Sawao Kato (JP), Alexei Nemov (RU), Max Whitlock (GB)
- Other greats: Artur Dalaloyan (RU), Epke Zonderland (NL)
- Prospects: Shinnosuke Oka (JP)
- Fact-check: medium

Nikolai Andrianov won 15 Olympic medals (7 gold) between 1972 and 1980. Kohei Uchimura is a two-time Olympic all-around champion (2012 and 2016) and won the world all-around title six straight times — many consider him the greatest gymnast in history. In the current era, Japan’s Daiki Hashimoto, Olympic all-around champion at Tokyo 2020, won his fourth straight world all-around title in Rotterdam in 2026; only Uchimura, with six, has more.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): List of multiple Olympic medalists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_multiple_Olympic_medalists)
- [NBC — Oka campeão do individual geral](https://www.nbcmiami.com/paris-2024-summer-olympics/mens-all-around-final-gymnastics-shinnosuke-oka/)
- [NBC Sports — quarto título mundial de Hashimoto](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/gymnastics-world-championships-2026-mens-all-around)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Daiki Hashimoto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daiki_Hashimoto)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de Ginástica de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_World_Artistic_Gymnastics_Championships)

### Women’s Artistic Swimming
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/nado-artistico-feminino
- GOAT: Natalia Ishchenko (RU), Svetlana Romashina (RU)
- Legends: Anastasia Davydova (RU), Alla Shishkina (RU)
- Stars: Yukiko Inui (JP), Miho Takeda (JP)
- Fact-check: medium

Natalia Ishchenko and Svetlana Romashina together have more than a dozen Olympic golds and dozens of world titles — Romashina is the most successful Olympic champion in artistic swimming history.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Svetlana Romashina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Svetlana_Romashina)

### Men’s Artistic Swimming
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/nado-artistico-masculino
- GOAT: Bill May (US)
- Legends: Giorgio Minisini (IT), Aleksandr Maltsev (RU)
- Stars: Dennis González (ES)
- Fact-check: medium

Bill May is the male pioneer of artistic swimming and a world champion in mixed duet, paving the way for men in the sport. Giorgio Minisini was world solo champion in 2024 before retiring, and Aleksandr Maltsev won both solo events at the 2025 World Championships.

Sources:
- [World Aquatics — Maltsev vence o solo livre](https://www.worldaquatics.com/news/4319239/aleksandr-maltsev-wins-mens-solo-free)

### Breaking
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/breaking
- GOAT: Menno van Gorp (NL)
- Legends: Lilou (FR), Hong 10 (KR)
- Stars: Thesis (US), Shigekix (JP)
- Other greats: Roxrite (US), Ami (JP), Phil Wizard (CA)
- Fact-check: low

Menno van Gorp holds the record of four Red Bull BC One titles, the main breaking event, the latest in 2024; Hong 10 won three times and Lilou was the first two-time champion. At breaking’s Olympic debut, Paris 2024, the champions were Phil Wizard and Ami, who also has two BC One titles.

Sources:
- [Guinness World Records — recorde do BC One](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/763052-most-wins-of-breakings-red-bull-bc-one-b-boy)

### Women’s Diving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/saltos-ornamentais-feminino
- GOAT: Fu Mingxia (CN)
- Legends: Guo Jingjing (CN), Ingrid Krämer (DE), Pat McCormick (US), Quan Hongchan (CN)
- Stars: Chen Ruolin (CN), Laura Wilkinson (US), Chen Yiwen (CN)
- Other greats: Zhou Jihong (CN), Lesley Bush (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Fu Mingxia won four Olympic golds and was world champion as a teenager, dominating springboard and platform. Quan Hongchan, platform champion at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024, already has three Olympic golds, and Chen Yiwen won two in Paris.

Sources:
- [NBC Olympics — China vence todos os saltos em Paris](https://www.nbcolympics.com/news/olympic-diving-paris-2024-china-sweeps-golds-plus-biggest-stories-replays-medal-results-and)

### Men’s Diving
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/saltos-ornamentais-masculino
- GOAT: Greg Louganis (US)
- Legends: Dmitry Sautin (RU), Chen Aisen (CN), Cao Yuan (CN)
- Stars: Tian Liang (CN), Matthew Mitcham (AU)
- Other greats: Tom Daley (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Greg Louganis won Olympic gold on both springboard and platform twice (1984 and 1988), considered the peak of the sport. Cao Yuan won four Olympic golds in three different events, the last at Paris 2024, when China won all eight diving events — an unprecedented sweep.

Sources:
- [NBC Olympics — China vence todos os saltos em Paris](https://www.nbcolympics.com/news/olympic-diving-paris-2024-china-sweeps-golds-plus-biggest-stories-replays-medal-results-and)

### Freestyle Football

- GOAT: Séan Garnier (FR)
- Legends: Andrew Henderson (GB), Tobias Becs (NO)
- Stars: Liv Cooke (GB), Lisa Zimouche (FR)
- Other greats: Ricardinho (BR), Melody Donchet (FR)
- Fact-check: low

Séan Garnier was the first Red Bull Street Style champion (2008) and is the great historic reference of freestyle football. Andrew Henderson won Street Style in 2014 and is credited as a five-time world champion; Liv Cooke and Mélody Donchet are the greatest female champions.

Sources:
- [Red Bull — histórico do Street Style](https://www.redbull.com/int-en/events/red-bull-street-style-championship/red-bull-street-style-event-history)

### Parkour
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/parkour
- GOAT: David Belle (FR)
- Legends: Sébastien Foucan (FR)
- Stars: Pasha Petkuns (LV), Tim Champion (GB), Ella Bucio (MX)
- Other greats: Ryan Doyle (GB), Luciano Balestra (IT)
- Fact-check: low

David Belle is recognized as co-founder of parkour, alongside Sébastien Foucan, with the Yamakasi group in France. At the official World Championships (2022 and 2024), Ella Bucio was the only athlete to win at both editions.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Parkour World Championships](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parkour_World_Championships)

### Women’s Rhythmic Gymnastics
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/ginastica-ritmica-feminino
- GOAT: Yevgeniya Kanayeva (RU)
- Legends: Dina Averina (RU), Alina Kabaeva (RU)
- Stars: Margarita Mamun (RU), Yana Kudryavtseva (RU), Darja Varfolomeev (DE)
- Other greats: Anna Bessonova (UA), Linoy Ashram (IL)
- Fact-check: medium

Yevgeniya Kanayeva is the only two-time Olympic all-around champion and the first to win all six golds at a World Championships. Dina Averina surpassed her total of world titles (18).

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evgeniya_Kanaeva)

### Women’s Trampoline

- GOAT: Rosie MacLennan (CA)
- Legends: Karen Cockburn (CA), Judy Wills Cline (US), Bryony Page (GB)
- Stars: He Wenna (CN), Zhu Xueying (CN)
- Fact-check: medium

Rosie MacLennan is the only two-time Olympic trampoline champion (2012 and 2016), after a 26-year career for Canada. Bryony Page completed her Olympic medal set with gold at Paris 2024, after silver in 2016 and bronze in 2020.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_trampoline_gymnasts)

### Men’s Trampoline
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/trampolim-masculino
- GOAT: Dong Dong (CN), Ivan Litvinovich (BY)
- Legends: Alexander Moskalenko (RU)
- Stars: Yuri Nikitin (UA)
- Fact-check: medium

Dong Dong won four straight Olympic medals (gold in 2012) and several world titles, the most consistent trampolinist in history. Ivan Litvinovich is the only man to win two Olympic trampoline titles (2020 and 2024).

Sources:
- [NBC Olympics — trampolim em Paris 2024](https://nbcolympics.com/post/297441)

## Motorsport

### Dakar Rally
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/rali-dakar
- GOAT: Stéphane Peterhansel (FR)
- Legends: Nasser Al-Attiyah (QA), Cyril Neveu (FR)
- Stars: Carlos Sainz (ES), Hubert Auriol (FR), Ari Vatanen (FI)
- Other greats: Toby Price (AU), Marc Coma (ES), Kevin Benavides (AR)
- Fact-check: medium

Stéphane Peterhansel, “Mr. Dakar”, won the rally 14 times — six on bikes and eight in cars — and is the only champion on three continents. Nasser Al-Attiyah reached his sixth car title in 2026, and on bikes Luciano Benavides won by just two seconds.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): 2026 Dakar Rally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Dakar_Rally)
- [Guinness World Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/78533-most-dakar-rally-wins)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St%C3%A9phane_Peterhansel)

### Drag Racing

John Force, called the GOAT by the NHRA itself, holds the records of 16 titles and 157 wins; he retired as a driver in 2025.

### Drifting

James Deane is the most successful champion in Formula Drift history, in the US, with a record five titles (2017, 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2025), plus several European titles.

### Endurance Racing (Le Mans)

### Formula 1
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/formula-1
- GOAT: Lewis Hamilton (GB), Michael Schumacher (DE)
- Legends: Juan Manuel Fangio (AR), Ayrton Senna (BR), Max Verstappen (NL)
- Stars: Alain Prost (FR), Sebastian Vettel (DE), Jim Clark (GB), Jackie Stewart (GB), Kimi Antonelli (IT)
- Other greats: Fernando Alonso (ES), Niki Lauda (AT), Lando Norris (GB)
- Fact-check: high

Lewis Hamilton and Michael Schumacher share the record of seven world titles. Hamilton holds the records for wins and pole positions; Schumacher redefined dominance in the Ferrari era, with five straight titles (2000–2004). Juan Manuel Fangio won five titles in the 1950s with the highest win rate in history, and Ayrton Senna, a three-time champion, is often voted the greatest by drivers and journalists. Max Verstappen won four straight titles (2021–2024), a record 19 races in one season (2023) and was voted driver of the year by the team bosses for the fifth straight time in 2025, when Lando Norris became champion by two points. In 2026, Italy’s Kimi Antonelli clinched the title for Mercedes at the Mexico City Grand Prix, with four races left, becoming at 20 the youngest champion in history.

Sources:
- [RacingNews365](https://racingnews365.com/2026-f1-championship-standings-after-italian-grand-prix-at-monza)
- [Speedcafe — Norris campeão em Abu Dhabi](https://speedcafe.com/f1-news-2025-abu-dhabi-grand-prix-result-outcome-lando-norris-world-champion-max-verstappen-win-oscar-piastri-result-standings/)
- [Wikipédia (EN): campeões mundiais de F1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Formula_One_World_Drivers%27_Champions)
- [Formula 1 — os chefes de equipe escolhem os melhores de 2025](https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/exclusive-the-f1-team-bosses-choose-their-top-10-drivers-of-2025.30ev5TbzHuK6hnaiv9k7KI)
- [ESPN — classificação de pilotos de 2026](https://www.espn.com/f1/standings)
- [Ranker — os maiores pilotos da história](https://www.ranker.com/list/greatest-f1-drivers-of-all-time/david-de-la-riva)
- [Sports Illustrated — Antonelli campeão no México](https://www.si.com/onsi/f1/news/f1-standings-and-results-as-kimi-antonelli-crowned-champion-at-mexican-grand-prix)
- [Wikipédia (EN): GP do México de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Mexico_City_Grand_Prix)

### Formula E
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/formula-e
- GOAT: Jean-Éric Vergne (FR), Pascal Wehrlein (DE)
- Legends: Sébastien Buemi (CH), Lucas di Grassi (BR)
- Stars: Oliver Rowland (GB), Mitch Evans (NZ), Jake Dennis (GB)
- Other greats: Nelson Piquet Jr. (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Jean-Éric Vergne and Pascal Wehrlein are the only two-time Formula E champions; Wehrlein won his second title in the 2025–26 season. Sébastien Buemi, champion in 2016, shares the records for wins (with Mitch Evans) and poles (with Vergne). Brazil’s Lucas di Grassi was champion in 2017, and Nelson Piquet Jr. won the first season (2015).

Sources:

### IndyCar

- GOAT: A.J. Foyt (US)

- Stars: Al Unser (US), Rick Mears (US)
- Other greats: Hélio Castroneves (BR), Emerson Fittipaldi (BR), Dario Franchitti (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

A.J. Foyt holds the IndyCar records for titles (7) and wins (67), plus four Indianapolis 500 victories. Scott Dixon has six titles, and Alex Palou reached his fifth in 2026, matching the record of four straight titles.

### Isle of Man TT
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tt-da-ilha-de-man
- GOAT: Michael Dunlop (GB)
- Legends: Joey Dunlop (GB)
- Stars: John McGuinness (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Michael Dunlop holds the record of 36 Isle of Man TT wins, the world’s most famous and dangerous motorcycle race on public roads, and won the last ten Supersport races up to 2026. He surpassed the 26 wins of his uncle, Joey Dunlop, the race’s historic legend.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Michael Dunlop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Dunlop)

### Karting
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/kart
- GOAT: Mike Wilson (GB)
- Legends: François Goldstein (BE)
- Stars: Davide Forè (IT), Danilo Rossi (IT)
- Other greats: Guido Sala (IT), Felice Rovelli (IT), Nyck de Vries (NL), Lorenzo Travisanutto (IT)
- Fact-check: medium

Mike Wilson holds the record of six karting world titles (1981, 1982, 1983, 1985, 1988 and 1989), still unbeaten. Ayrton Senna called him the best karter he had ever seen; after retiring, he founded the Rakama chassis brand and coached drivers such as Fernando Alonso. He died in January 2026.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Karting World Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karting_World_Championship)

### Motocross
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/motocross
- GOAT: Stefan Everts (BE)
- Legends: Tony Cairoli (IT), Jeffrey Herlings (NL), Ricky Carmichael (US)
- Stars: Joël Robert (BE), Roger De Coster (BE), Joël Smets (BE), Georges Jobé (BE), Eric Geboers (BE), Tim Gajser (SI)
- Other greats: Heikki Mikkola (FI), Torsten Hallman (SE), Harry Everts (BE), Jorge Prado (ES), Broc Glover (US), James Stewart Jr. (US)
- Fact-check: high

Stefan Everts is widely considered the best motocross rider of all time. He won 10 world titles in different classes and a record 101 Grands Prix. He was also the first rider to win three races in three different classes on the same day, and is the only world champion with all four big Japanese brands (Suzuki, Kawasaki, Honda and Yamaha).

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Motocross World Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motocross_World_Championship)

### MotoGP
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/motogp
- GOAT: Giacomo Agostini (IT)
- Legends: Valentino Rossi (IT), Marc Márquez (ES)
- Stars: Mick Doohan (AU), Geoff Duke (GB), John Surtees (GB), Mike Hailwood (GB), Eddie Lawson (US), Kenny Roberts (US), Wayne Rainey (US), Jorge Lorenzo (ES)
- Other greats: Umberto Masetti (IT), Phil Read (GB), Barry Sheene (GB), Freddie Spencer (US), Casey Stoner (AU), Francesco Bagnaia (IT), Jorge Martín (ES)
- Fact-check: high

Giacomo Agostini is the most successful champion in motorcycle road racing history: 15 world titles — 8 in the premier class — and 122 Grand Prix wins in the 1960s and 1970s. Valentino Rossi and Marc Márquez have 7 premier-class titles each; Márquez reached his seventh in 2025 and has 9 world titles in total.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (PT): MotoGP](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/MotoGP)

- Fact-check: high

Toni Bou is the most successful champion in motorcycle trials history: in 2026 he reached 40 straight world titles — 20 in TrialGP (outdoor) and 20 in X-Trial (indoor) — dominating the sport since 2007.

### Speedway

- GOAT: Ivan Mauger (NZ), Tony Rickardsson (SE), Bartosz Zmarzlik (PL)
- Other greats: Robert Lambert (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Ivan Mauger, Tony Rickardsson and Bartosz Zmarzlik share the record of six speedway world titles, the brakeless motorcycle racing on dirt ovals. Mauger is traditionally named the greatest in history; Zmarzlik reached his sixth title in 2025 and nearly a seventh in 2026, when Britain’s Robert Lambert became champion for the first time.

### Superbike
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/superbike

- Stars: Troy Bayliss (AU), Álvaro Bautista (ES), Colin Edwards (US)
- Other greats: Nicolò Bulega (IT)
- Fact-check: medium

Jonathan Rea won six straight world titles (2015–2020) and holds the records for wins, podiums and points in World Superbike history. Toprak Razgatlıoğlu was a three-time champion (2021, 2024 and 2025) before moving to MotoGP.

### Chase Tag
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/chase-tag
- GOAT: Kyle Soderman (US)
- Fact-check: low

World Chase Tag, created in 2012 by brothers Christian and Damien Devaux in the UK, turned the playground game of tag into a professional sport, with team matches in an obstacle arena. Team Marrero Gang won the first three world championships; individual athletes do not yet have an established ranking.

Marianne Vos is an Olympic and world champion on the road, in cyclocross and on the track, with titles across three decades. - Stars: Chris Froome (GB), Fausto Coppi (IT)
- Other greats: Greg LeMond (US), Gino Bartali (IT), Jonas Vingegaard (DK)
- Fact-check: low

Eddy Merckx won 5 Tours de France, 5 Giros, 1 Vuelta and every major classic, with more than 500 wins — records that make him the greatest cyclist in history. Tadej Pogačar won his fifth Tour de France in 2026, tying the record of Merckx, Jacques Anquetil, Bernard Hinault and Miguel Indurain.

### Women’s Skateboarding
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/skate-feminino
- GOAT: Rayssa Leal (BR)
- Legends: Letícia Bufoni (BR)
- Stars: Aori Nishimura (JP), Pâmela Rosa (BR), Coco Yoshizawa (JP), Arisa Trew (AU)
- Other greats: Leo Baker (US), Marissa Dal Santo (US), Lizzie Armanto (US/FI)
- Fact-check: medium

Rayssa Leal, “the Little Fairy”, won Olympic silver at 13 and bronze at Paris 2024, plus two SLS Super Crown titles. At Paris 2024, Coco Yoshizawa won street and Arisa Trew won park, both aged 14.

Sources:
- [SLS — street feminino em Paris 2024](https://www.streetleague.com/post/sls-skaters-dominate-olympic-street-skating-finals-claiming-5-medals-in-paris)

### Men’s Skateboarding
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/skate-masculino
- GOAT: Nyjah Huston (US), Bob Burnquist (BR)
- Legends: Rodney Mullen (US), Tony Hawk (US), Yuto Horigome (JP)
- Stars: Daewon Song (US), Paul Rodriguez (US), Pedro Barros (BR), Keegan Palmer (AU)
- Other greats: Tom Schaar (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Nyjah Huston is the most successful street skater in history (X Games, SLS and World Championships). Bob Burnquist is the most decorated athlete in X Games history and a vert legend. At the Olympics, Yuto Horigome won street twice (2020 and 2024) and Keegan Palmer won park twice.

Sources:
- [SuperSport — skate em Paris 2024](https://supersport.com/olympic%20games%20paris%202024/general/news/ccb4e5ab-9eb8-4020-a7c5-32c501c31025/japan-and-australia-extend-dominance-at-paris-games)

Janja Garnbret is a two-time Olympic champion (2020 and 2024) and the most successful athlete in climbing World Cup history.

Adam Ondra was the first to climb a 9c route (Silence, 2017) and has piled up world titles in sport climbing.

### Women’s Surfing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/surfe-feminino

- Legends: Layne Beachley (AU), Carissa Moore (US)
- Stars: Caroline Marks (US)
- Other greats: Tatiana Weston-Webb (BR), Molly Picklum (AU), Caitlin Simmers (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Stephanie Gilmore is the most successful champion in women’s surfing history, with eight world titles. Layne Beachley won seven and Carissa Moore five. In the new generation, Caitlin Simmers was champion in 2024 and Molly Picklum in 2025.

Sources:

- GOAT: Kelly Slater (US)

- Stars: Tom Curren (US)
- Other greats: Italo Ferreira (BR), Filipe Toledo (BR), Yago Dora (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Kelly Slater won 11 world titles and is both the youngest and the oldest champion in pro surfing history. Gabriel Medina and John John Florence are three-time world champions, and Yago Dora gave Brazil its eighth world title in 2025.

Sources:
- [SurferToday — Dora e Picklum campeões de 2025](https://www.surfertoday.com/surfing/yago-dora-and-molly-picklum-crowned-2025-wsl-world-champions)

- Stars: Emma Hinze (DE)
- Fact-check: low

Laura Kenny has five Olympic golds, a record among British women. Anna Meares was Olympic champion in two events and an 11-time world champion, dominating sprinting for more than a decade. Ellesse Andrews won the sprint and keirin at Paris 2024.

Sources:

- Stars: Daniel Morelon (FR), Grégory Baugé (FR)
- Fact-check: medium

Chris Hoy has 6 Olympic golds and 11 world titles, the most successful track cyclist at the global level. Jason Kenny surpassed his Olympic gold total (7). Harrie Lavreysen reached five Olympic golds, three of them at Paris 2024.

## Winter

### Women’s Alpine Skiing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-alpino-feminino
- GOAT: Mikaela Shiffrin (US)
- Legends: Lindsey Vonn (US)
- Stars: Petra Vlhová (SK), Federica Brignone (IT)
- Fact-check: low

Mikaela Shiffrin is the winningest skier in Alpine World Cup history, with 108 victories, men and women combined. At Milan-Cortina 2026 she won her third Olympic gold (slalom).

Sources:
- [NBC Olympics](https://www.nbcmiami.com/olympics/2026-milan-cortina/mikaela-shiffrin-gold-medal-slalom/)

Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-alpino-masculino
- GOAT: Ingemar Stenmark (SE)
- Legends: Marcel Hirscher (AT)
- Stars: Marco Odermatt (CH)
- Other greats: Hermann Maier (AT), Lucas Pinheiro Braathen (BR)
- Fact-check: low

Ingemar Stenmark won 86 World Cup races, still the men’s record, dominating slalom and giant slalom. At Milan-Cortina 2026, Lucas Pinheiro Braathen won the giant slalom, giving Brazil the first Winter Olympic medal in South American history.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

Magdalena Neuner is the most successful woman in biathlon World Championship history, a two-time Olympic champion and three-time overall World Cup winner, despite retiring at 25.

- Fact-check: medium

Ole Einar Bjørndalen, the “King of Biathlon”, has 13 Olympic medals (8 gold) and the World Cup records for wins (94) and podiums. Johannes Thingnes Bø, a five-time Olympic champion, retired in 2025.

- Fact-check: medium

Johannes Høsflot Klæbo won all six events he entered at Milan-Cortina 2026 and reached 11 Olympic golds, the all-time Winter Games record — second only to Michael Phelps among all Olympians.

Jennifer Jones is an unbeaten Olympic champion (2014), world champion and record holder for Canadian titles, cited by her own rivals as one of the greatest of all time. Anna Hasselborg won her second Olympic title in 2026 (after 2018).

Kevin Martin, Olympic champion in 2010, was voted Canada’s greatest skip in 2019 by journalists and players. Niklas Edin is the most successful world champion of the modern era. Brad Jacobs was Olympic champion in 2014 and 2026.

Kim Yuna was Olympic champion in 2010 with a world record score and won a medal at every competition of her career. At Milan-Cortina 2026, Alysa Liu became Olympic champion, ahead of three-time world champion Kaori Sakamoto.

### Men’s Figure Skating
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/patinacao-artistica-masculino
- GOAT: Yuzuru Hanyu (JP)
- Legends: Evgeni Plushenko (RU)
- Stars: Nathan Chen (US), Ilia Malinin (US)
- Other greats: Brian Boitano (US), Mikhail Shaidorov (KZ)
- Fact-check: low

Yuzuru Hanyu won back-to-back Olympic titles (2014 and 2018), the first man to do so in 66 years, and broke scoring world records several times. Ilia Malinin, a two-time world champion and the first to land a quadruple Axel, missed the podium at Milan-Cortina 2026, where gold went to Mikhail Shaidorov.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

Mikaël Kingsbury is the greatest moguls skier in history: he reached 100 World Cup wins in 2026 and has nine world titles. At Milan-Cortina 2026 he won gold in dual moguls and silver in moguls, the second Olympic title of his career.

Tessa Virtue and Scott Moir have five Olympic medals (three gold), a figure skating record, and won in 2018 with a record score. Guillaume Cizeron was Olympic champion in 2022 with Gabriella Papadakis and in 2026 with Laurence Fournier Beaudry.

- GOAT: Martins Dukurs (LV)
- Legends: Yun Sung-bin (KR), Christopher Grotheer (DE)
- Stars: Alexander Tretiakov (RU)
- Other greats: Matt Weston (GB)
- Fact-check: low

Martins Dukurs led the World Cup for ten straight seasons and is considered the greatest skeleton slider in history, despite never winning Olympic gold. Matt Weston was the 2026 Olympic champion.

Sources:
- [Olympics.com](https://olympics.com/en/news/yarnold-and-yun-make-olympic-skeleton-history)
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

### Women’s Ski Jumping
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/salto-de-esqui-feminino
- GOAT: Sara Takanashi (JP)
- Legends: Maren Lundby (NO)
- Stars: Daniela Iraschko-Stolz (AT), Katharina Schmid (DE), Nika Prevc (SI)
- Other greats: Ema Klinec (SI), Anna Odine Strøm (NO)
- Fact-check: medium

Sara Takanashi is the only ski jumper, man or woman, with more than 60 individual World Cup wins. Nika Prevc has dominated the World Cup since 2025, and Anna Odine Strøm won both individual events at Milan-Cortina 2026.

Sources:
- [Red Bull](https://www.redbull.com/int-en/top-greatest-ski-jumpers)
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

### Men’s Ski Jumping
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/salto-de-esqui-masculino
- GOAT: Matti Nykänen (FI)
- Legends: Kamil Stoch (PL), Gregor Schlierenzauer (AT)
- Stars: Adam Małysz (PL), Janne Ahonen (FI), Simon Ammann (CH), Ryōyū Kobayashi (JP)
- Other greats: Stefan Kraft (AT), Halvor Egner Granerud (NO), Domen Prevc (SI)
- Fact-check: medium

Matti Nykänen is the only ski jumper to win all five major individual titles, with four Olympic golds and five world titles. In 2026 Domen Prevc won the Olympic large hill.

Sources:
- [Red Bull](https://www.redbull.com/int-en/top-greatest-ski-jumpers)
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

### Women’s Ski Mountaineering
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-de-montanha-feminino
- Legends: Laetitia Roux (FR), Axelle Gachet-Mollaret (FR)
- Stars: Marianne Fatton (CH), Emily Harrop (FR)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: ski mountaineering debuted at the Olympics in 2026. Laetitia Roux and Axelle Gachet-Mollaret dominated the World Championships and World Cup before the Olympic era. At Milan-Cortina, Switzerland’s Marianne Fatton became the sport’s first Olympic champion, in the sprint, and France’s Emily Harrop won the mixed relay.

Sources:
- [Olympics.com — Fatton, primeira campeã olímpica](https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/news/winter-olympics-2026-ski-mountaineering-marianne-fatton-wins-skimo-first-olympic-gold-womens-sprint-milano-cortina-2026)
- [Wikipédia (EN): sprint feminino em 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ski_mountaineering_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Women%27s_sprint)

### Men’s Ski Mountaineering
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-de-montanha-masculino
- Legends: Kilian Jornet (ES), Robert Antonioli (IT)
- Stars: Oriol Cardona Coll (ES), Thibault Anselmet (FR)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: ski mountaineering (skimo) debuted at the Winter Olympics at Milan-Cortina 2026. Kilian Jornet was a multiple world and World Cup champion, and Robert Antonioli has seven world titles and four overall World Cups. At the Olympic debut, Spain’s Oriol Cardona Coll won the sprint and Thibault Anselmet took the mixed relay for France.

Sources:
- [Olympics.com — resultados do esqui de montanha em 2026](https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/milano-cortina-2026/results/ski-mountaineering)
- [Wikipédia (EN): sprint masculino em 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ski_mountaineering_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_sprint)
- [Trail Running Spain — título de Kilian Jornet](https://trailrunningspain.com/2016/03/19/kilian-jornet-wins-indivual-skimo-world-cup-for-the-fourth-time-and-doubles-up-with-the-vertical-title/)

### Women’s Snowboarding
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/snowboard-feminino
- GOAT: Chloe Kim (US)
- Legends: Kelly Clark (US), Hannah Teter (US)
- Stars: Jamie Anderson (US), Anna Gasser (AT)
- Other greats: Tara Dakides (US), Maddie Mastro (US), Kokomo Murase (JP)
- Prospects: Choi Ga-on (KR)
- Fact-check: low

Chloe Kim is a two-time Olympic halfpipe champion (2018 and 2022), with world and X Games titles since her teens; in 2026 she took silver behind South Korea’s Choi Ga-on.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

### Men’s Snowboarding
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/snowboard-masculino
- GOAT: Shaun White (US)
- Legends: Terje Håkonsen (NO), Mark McMorris (CA)
- Stars: Scotty James (AU), Sage Kotsenburg (US)
- Other greats: Travis Rice (US), Danny Davis (US), Yuto Totsuka (JP), Su Yiming (CN)
- Fact-check: low

Shaun White is a three-time Olympic halfpipe champion (2006, 2010 and 2018) and the X Games medal record holder. At Milan-Cortina 2026, Yuto Totsuka won the halfpipe and Su Yiming the slopestyle.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

### Women’s Speed Skating
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/patinacao-de-velocidade-feminino
- GOAT: Ireen Wüst (NL)
- Legends: Claudia Pechstein (DE), Bonnie Blair (US)
- Stars: Gunda Niemann-Stirnemann (DE), Lidiya Skoblikova (RU), Martina Sáblíková (CZ)
- Other greats: Miho Takagi (JP), Irene Schouten (NL), Jutta Leerdam (NL), Femke Kok (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Ireen Wüst has 13 Olympic medals (6 gold), the highest total in speed skating, and was the first athlete in any sport to win individual golds at five straight Olympics.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Olympic_medalists_in_speed_skating)

### Men’s Speed Skating
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/patinacao-de-velocidade-masculino
- GOAT: Sven Kramer (NL)
- Legends: Eric Heiden (US)
- Stars: Shani Davis (US), Johann Olav Koss (NO), Ard Schenk (NL), Jordan Stolz (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Sven Kramer holds the records of nine allround world titles, ten European titles and 21 single-distance world golds. Eric Heiden won five golds at a single Olympics (1980). Jordan Stolz won the 500 m and 1000 m at Milan-Cortina 2026.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sven_Kramer)
- [Wikipédia (EN): medalhistas de 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_2026_Winter_Olympics_medal_winners)

## Paralympic

### Blind Football (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/futebol-de-cegos-masculino
- GOAT: Ricardinho (BR), Jefinho (BR)
- Legends: Mizael Conrado (BR)
- Stars: Maximiliano Espinillo (AR), Frédéric Villeroux (FR)
- Other greats: Nonato (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Jefinho (2010) and Ricardinho (2014) were named the world’s best and led Brazil, champion of the first five Paralympic tournaments (2004–2020) and the powerhouse of blind football. At Paris 2024, France became the first other champion, with Frédéric Villeroux’s decisive penalty, and Brazil took bronze with a goal from Jefinho.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional](https://www.paralympic.org/feature/no-21-brazil-remain-undisputed-champions)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jefinho_(Paralympic_footballer))
- [ClickOrlando (AP) — França campeã em Paris 2024](https://www.clickorlando.com/news/2024/09/07/france-wins-gold-in-blind-football-at-paralympics-under-eiffel-tower-lights/)

### Boccia (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/bocha-paralimpica
- GOAT: Jeong Ho-won (KR), Dirceu Pinto (BR)
- Stars: Maciel Santos (BR), David Smith (GB)
- Fact-check: low

At Paris 2024, Jeong Ho-won won his fourth Paralympic boccia gold, crowning a 26-year career. Brazil’s Dirceu Pinto also won four Paralympic golds, at Beijing 2008 and London 2012, in individual and pairs, and won practically everything in the sport before his death in 2020.

Sources:
- [Asia News Network](https://asianews.network/?p=165006)
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Dirceu Pinto](https://www.paralympic.org/es/news/ipc-lamenta-el-fallecimiento-de-dirceu-jose-pinto)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Dirceu Pinto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dirceu_Pinto)

### Goalball (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/goalball-masculino
- GOAT: Leomon Moreno (BR)
- Fact-check: low

Leomon Moreno is considered the best goalball player in the world: a three-time world champion (2014, 2018 and 2022), Paralympic champion at Tokyo 2020 and the all-time top scorer at World Championships.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional](https://www.paralympic.org/leomon-moreno)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leomon_Moreno)

### Para Alpine Skiing (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-alpino-paralimpico
- GOAT: Gerd Schönfelder (DE), Reinhild Möller (DE)
- Fact-check: medium

Germany’s Gerd Schönfelder and Reinhild Möller share the Para alpine skiing record with 16 golds each, and are the two winter athletes who came closest to Ragnhild Myklebust’s 22 golds.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Ragnhild Myklebust relembra a carreira](https://www.paralympic.org/news/pyeongchang-2018-ragnhild-myklebust-recalls-glory-days)

### Para Archery (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tiro-com-arco-paralimpico
- GOAT: Zahra Nemati (IR)
- Legends: Matt Stutzman (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Iran’s Zahra Nemati won three Paralympic titles in individual recurve (London 2012, Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020) and also competed at the Rio Olympics, as Iran’s flag bearer. The USA’s Matt Stutzman, the “Armless Archer” who shoots with his feet, won compound gold at Paris 2024 with 149 out of 150, a Paralympic record.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Zahra Nemati](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zahra_Nemati)
- [World Archery — Nemati, lenda do tiro com arco paralímpico](https://www.worldarchery.sport/news/201662/)

- [WOWT — Stutzman faz história em Paris](https://www.wowt.com/2024/09/03/armless-archer-matt-stutzman-makes-history-gold-medal-win-usa-paris-paralympics)

### Para Athletics (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/atletismo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Franz Nietlispach (CH), Chantal Petitclerc (CA)
- Legends: Tatyana McFadden (US), Tanni Grey-Thompson (GB), Heinz Frei (CH)
- Stars: David Weir (GB), Marcel Hug (CH), Markus Rehm (DE)
- Other greats: Petrúcio Ferreira (BR), Terezinha Guilhermina (BR), Yohansson Nascimento (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Franz Nietlispach and Chantal Petitclerc share the record of 14 Paralympic golds in athletics, both in wheelchair racing. Tatyana McFadden has 20 Paralympic medals (8 gold) and is one of the greatest wheelchair marathoners in history.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional](https://www.paralympic.org/news/sport-week-para-athletics-top-5-moments)
- [Paralympic.ca](https://paralympic.ca/athlete/chantal-petitclerc/)

### Para Badminton (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/badminton-paralimpico
- GOAT: Cheah Liek Hou (MY)
- Stars: Leani Ratri Oktila (ID)
- Fact-check: medium

Malaysia’s Cheah Liek Hou is the biggest name in Para badminton, which joined the Games at Tokyo 2020: he won the SU5 singles in Tokyo and at Paris 2024 and is an eight-time singles world champion. Indonesia’s Leani Ratri Oktila was one of the stars of the sport’s debut in Tokyo.

Sources:
- [Malay Mail — ouro de Cheah em Paris 2024](https://www.malaymail.com/news/sports/2024/09/03/our-champion-paralympian-badminton-player-liek-hou-wins-malaysias-maiden-gold-in-paris/149028)

### Para Canoe (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/canoagem-paralimpica
- GOAT: Curtis McGrath (AU)
- Legends: Emma Wiggs (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Australia’s Curtis McGrath is the most decorated canoeist in Paralympic history: he won the KL2 K1 200 m at Rio 2016, Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 and has also won in va’a. Great Britain’s Emma Wiggs is the leading champion among women, adding another VL2 va’a gold at Paris 2024.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — o legado de ouro de McGrath](https://www.paralympic.org/paris-2024/news/australian-curtis-mcgrath-continues-golden-legacy)

### Para Cycling (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/ciclismo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Sarah Storey (GB)
- Legends: Alessandro Zanardi (IT)
- Stars: Jody Cundy (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Sarah Storey is the most successful British athlete in Paralympic history: she reached 19 golds and 30 medals at Paris 2024 — five golds in swimming and 14 in cycling — across nine Paralympics.

Sources:
- [UCI — 19º ouro paralímpico de Sarah Storey](https://uci.org/article/paralympic-games-paris-2024-sarah-storey-wins-19th-paralympic-gold-of-her/49MXH1okltiUFXEPD1l9Ki)

### Para Ice Hockey (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/hoquei-no-gelo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Declan Farmer (US)
- Legends: Billy Bridges (CA), Josh Pauls (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Declan Farmer is the all-time leading scorer in Para ice hockey, having passed Canada’s Billy Bridges. A four-time Paralympic champion (Sochi 2014, PyeongChang 2018, Beijing 2022 and Milano Cortina 2026), he was named MVP at Milano Cortina, where he set the record for points at a single Games. Captain Josh Pauls was part of all five straight US golds, from Vancouver 2010 to 2026.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Farmer, MVP de Milão-Cortina 2026](https://www.paralympic.org/news/declan-farmer-named-milano-cortina-2026-paralympic-mvp)

- [Wikipédia (EN): hóquei no gelo paralímpico em 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Para_ice_hockey_at_the_2026_Winter_Paralympics)

### Para Judo (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/judo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Antônio Tenório (BR)
- Fact-check: medium

Brazil’s Antônio Tenório is the most successful judoka in Paralympic history: four straight titles, from Atlanta 1996 to Beijing 2008, then bronze at London 2012 and another medal at Rio 2016, reaching the podium at six Paralympics.

Sources:
- [IBSA — história do judô paralímpico](https://ibsasport.org/sports/judo/about/history/)
- [JudoInside — Antônio Tenório](https://www.judoinside.com/judoka/89873/Antonio_Tenorio)

### Para Nordic Skiing (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esqui-nordico-paralimpico
- GOAT: Ragnhild Myklebust (NO)
- Legends: Brian McKeever (CA), Oksana Masters (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Norway’s Ragnhild Myklebust is the greatest athlete in Winter Paralympic history: 22 golds and 27 medals across five Games (1988 to 2002), in cross-country skiing, biathlon and ice sledge racing. Canada’s Brian McKeever retired at Beijing 2022 with 16 golds, the men’s record at the Winter Games, and the USA’s Oksana Masters reached 24 Paralympic medals at Milano Cortina 2026, where she won four golds in biathlon and cross-country.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Ragnhild Myklebust](https://www.paralympic.org/news/pyeongchang-2018-ragnhild-myklebust-recalls-glory-days)
- [Comitê Paralímpico Canadense — despedida de Brian McKeever](https://paralympic.ca/news/canadian-paralympic-sport-awards-brian-mckeever-closes-out-legendary-career-beijing/)
- [AP (ClickOnDetroit) — Oksana Masters em Milão-Cortina 2026](https://www.clickondetroit.com/sports/2026/03/10/oksana-masters-roars-to-paralympic-redemption-at-milan-cortina-with-11th-gold-medal/)
- [Universidade de Illinois — 24 medalhas de Oksana Masters](https://www.ahs.illinois.edu/?p=19435)

### Para Powerlifting (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/halterofilismo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Siamand Rahman (IR)
- Legends: Sherif Osman (EG)
- Fact-check: medium

Siamand Rahman was the strongest man in Paralympic history: champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016 in the over-107 kg class, he was the first to bench 270 kg in Para powerlifting and, in Rio, set the world record of 310 kg. He died in 2020, aged 31. Egypt’s Sherif Osman won three Paralympic titles in the lighter classes (Beijing 2008, London 2012 and Rio 2016) and silver at Tokyo 2020.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — grandes levantadores no Rio 2016](https://www.paralympic.org/news/sport-week-big-lifters-expected-rio-2016)
- [Guinness World Records — maior levantamento paralímpico](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/104741-heaviest-powerlift-100-kg-male)
- [Rudaw — morte de Siamand Rahman](https://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/iran/020320201-amp)
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Sherif Osman em Paris 2024](https://www.paralympic.org/paris-2024/feature/egypt-legend-sherif-osman-la-2028-and-big-ambitions)

### Para Swimming (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/natacao-paralimpica
- GOAT: Trischa Zorn (US)
- Legends: Béatrice Hess (FR), Jessica Long (US), Michael Edgson (CA), Daniel Dias (BR)
- Stars: Ihar Boki (BY), Mayumi Narita (JP), Erin Popovich (US), Matthew Cowdrey (AU), Erling Trondsen (NO)
- Other greats: Claudia Hengst (DE), Natalie du Toit (ZA), John Morgan (US), Uri Bergman (IL), Sophie Pascoe (NZ), David Roberts (GB), Joseph Wengier (US), Magdalena Tjernberg (SE), Elizabeth Scott (US), Marijke Ruiter (NL), Christopher Holmes (GB), Priya Cooper (AU), Jacqueline Freney (AU), Stephanie Dixon (CA), Siobhan Paton (AU)
- Fact-check: medium

Trischa Zorn, a blind swimmer, won 55 Paralympic medals, 41 of them gold, between 1980 and 2004 — the highest total in Paralympic history. Jessica Long reached 30 medals (17 gold) at Paris 2024, and Brazil’s Daniel Dias, with 27 medals and 14 golds, is the most decorated male Paralympic swimmer ever.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Swimming at the Summer Paralympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swimming_at_the_Summer_Paralympics)
- [Swimswam — Daniel Dias, nadador mais condecorado](https://swimswam.com/daniel-dias-becomes-decorated-paralympic-male-swimmer-history/)
- [NBC Sports — Jessica Long](https://www.nbcsports.com/olympics/news/jessica-long-usa-tokyo-paralympics-second-most-decorated)

### Para Table Tennis (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-de-mesa-paralimpico
- GOAT: Natalia Partyka (PL)
- Stars: Qian Yang (AU)
- Fact-check: medium

Natalia Partyka is the most decorated table tennis player in Paralympic history: she won the class 10 singles at four straight Games (2004 to 2016) and has six golds. She also played at four Olympics, from 2008 to 2020, something unprecedented in table tennis. Australia’s Qian Yang ended her streak at Tokyo 2020, and Partyka took singles silver and doubles bronze at Paris 2024.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Natalia Partyka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natalia_Partyka)
- [ITTF — Partyka, a mais condecorada](https://ittf.com/2016/09/11/shaking-like-leaf-sense-occasion-whether-debut-decorated)
- [ETTU — Partyka quer recuperar a coroa](https://ettu.org/en-n-news-2024-september-partyka-is-determined-to-reclaim-her-crown)
- [Polskie Radio — medalhas da Polônia em Paris 2024](https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7790/artykul/3420678,two-more-paralympic-medals-for-poland-sports-ministry)

### Para Triathlon (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/triatlo-paralimpico
- GOAT: Martin Schulz (DE), Grace Norman (US)
- Legends: Lauren Steadman (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Triathlon joined the Paralympic Games at Rio 2016. Germany’s Martin Schulz won in Rio and at Tokyo 2020, and the USA’s Grace Norman took gold in Rio and at Paris 2024, with silver in Tokyo. Great Britain’s Lauren Steadman was champion in Tokyo.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — Grace Norman e uma década de triatlo](https://www.paralympic.org/feature/rio-2016-grace-norman-decade-para-triathlon)
- [World Triathlon — as rivalidades da PTS5 em Paris](https://triathlon.org/news/mouthwatering-pts5-paralympic-triathlon-rivalries-ready-to-light-up-paris)
- [Tri247 — Lauren Steadman](https://www.tri247.com/triathletes/lauren-steadman)

### Sitting Volleyball (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/volei-sentado-masculino
- GOAT: Morteza Mehrzad (IR)
- Fact-check: medium

Morteza Mehrzad, the tallest Paralympian in history (2.46 m), is the pillar of Iran, three straight times Paralympic champion (2016, 2020 and 2024); he was the top scorer of the 2016 final and was named the world’s best player in 2019, 2021 and 2022.

Sources:
- [NBC Sports — Morteza Mehrzad](https://nbcsports.com/olympics/news/morteza-mehrzad-tallest-paralympian-iran-sitting-volleyball)
- [CNN — Mehrzad em Paris 2024](https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2024/08/30/sport/morteza-mehrzadselakjani-paralympics-spt-intl)

### Women’s Wheelchair Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-em-cadeira-de-rodas-feminino
- GOAT: Chantal Benoit (CA)
- Stars: Mareike Miller (DE), Janet McLachlan (CA)
- Fact-check: medium

Chantal Benoit played at seven Paralympics and won three Paralympic titles (1992, 1996 and 2000); the Ottawa Sports Hall of Fame describes her as the best player of all time. In the current era, the Netherlands won back-to-back Paralympic titles (2020 and 2024).

Sources:
- [Ottawa Sport Hall of Fame](https://ottawasporthall.ca/2023/12/30/chantal-benoit/)
- [NBC Olympics — último dia de Paris 2024](https://www.nbcolympics.com/post/299416)

### Men’s Wheelchair Basketball
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/basquete-em-cadeira-de-rodas-masculino
- GOAT: Patrick Anderson (CA)
- Legends: Henk Makkenze (NL)
- Stars: Gregg Warburton (GB)
- Fact-check: medium

Patrick Anderson is widely recognized as the greatest player in history: a three-time Paralympic champion (2000, 2004 and 2012) and 2006 world champion.

Sources:
- [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2024/09/16/1257825197/paralympic-games-wheelchair-basketball-patrick-anderson-paris)
- [Laureus](https://laureus.com/world-sports-awards/2013/laureus-world-sportsperson-of-the-year-with-a-disability/patrick-anderson)

### Wheelchair Fencing (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/esgrima-em-cadeira-de-rodas
- GOAT: Beatrice “Bebe” Vio (IT), Yu Chui Yee (HK)
- Legends: Pál Szekeres (HU)
- Fact-check: medium

Bebe Vio is the biggest name in wheelchair fencing: two-time champion in category B foil (Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020), two-time world and European champion, she returned to the podium with two bronzes at Paris 2024. Hong Kong’s Yu Chui Yee won four golds on her debut at Athens 2004 and three more between Beijing 2008 and Rio 2016. Hungary’s Pál Szekeres is the only fencer with both Olympic and Paralympic medals.

Sources:
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — segundo ouro de Bebe Vio](https://www.paralympic.org/news/bebe-vio-makes-history-second-paralympic-gold-medal-wheelchair-fencing)
- [Comitê Paralímpico Internacional — grandes momentos da esgrima em cadeira de rodas](https://www.paralympic.org/feature/sport-week-top-moments-wheelchair-fencing)
- [ANSA — bronze de Bebe Vio em Paris 2024](https://ansa.it/english/news/2024/09/04/paris-bebe-vio-bronze-in-category-b-foil_10cbf998-6ebb-437d-813d-c2106215cb17.html)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Beatrice Vio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beatrice_Vio)

### Wheelchair Rugby (Paralympic)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/rugby-em-cadeira-de-rodas
- Legends: Ryley Batt (AU)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: Australia’s Ryley Batt is the name most often cited as the best player in history, a two-time Paralympic champion (2012 and 2016). The Paralympic title has changed hands in recent editions: Great Britain at Tokyo 2020 and Japan, for the first time, at Paris 2024, beating the US in the final.

Sources:
- [IPC — os 24 momentos de Paris 2024](https://www.paralympic.org/feature/top-24-moments-paris-2024-13-24)
- [Team USA — terceira prata seguida dos EUA](https://teamusa.com/video/us-wheelchair-rugby-earns-third-straight-silver-at-the-paralympic-games-paris-2024)

### Women’s Wheelchair Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-em-cadeira-de-rodas-feminino
- GOAT: Esther Vergeer (NL)
- Legends: Diede de Groot (NL)
- Stars: Yui Kamiji (JP), Jiske Griffioen (NL)
- Other greats: Aniek van Koot (NL), Chantal Vandierendonck (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Esther Vergeer went unbeaten for 470 matches and won 7 Paralympic golds and more than 40 Grand Slam titles — the ITF calls her possibly the greatest wheelchair tennis player of all time.

Sources:
- [ITF](https://www.itftennis.com/en/news-and-media/articles/esther-vergeer-by-the-numbers/)

### Men’s Wheelchair Tennis
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tenis-em-cadeira-de-rodas-masculino
- GOAT: Shingo Kunieda (JP)
- Legends: David Hall (AU), Stéphane Houdet (FR), Tokito Oda (JP), Alfie Hewett (GB)
- Stars: Gustavo Fernández (AR)
- Other greats: Gordon Reid (GB), Robin Ammerlaan (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Shingo Kunieda is the most successful men’s wheelchair tennis player in history, with dozens of Grand Slam titles and a career Golden Slam completed at Wimbledon 2022; he retired in 2023. In the new generation, Tokito Oda became the youngest Paralympic singles champion at Paris 2024, beating Alfie Hewett, who took gold in doubles.

Sources:
- [LTA](https://www.lta.org.uk/fan-zone/50-years-of-wheelchair-tennis-exhibition/international-game/)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Wheelchair tennis at the 2024 Summer Paralympics – Mens singles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wheelchair_tennis_at_the_2024_Summer_Paralympics_%E2%80%93_Men%27s_singles)

## Mind

### Bridge
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/bridge
- GOAT: Bob Hamman (US)
- Legends: Giorgio Belladonna (IT)
- Stars: Zia Mahmood (PK/US)
- Fact-check: low

Bob Hamman is considered one of the greatest bridge players of all time, with around ten Bermuda Bowls, the world team championship, between 1970 and 1995. Giorgio Belladonna was the star of Italy’s Blue Team, which won 12 world titles in 13 years (1957–1969). Zia Mahmood led Pakistan to the world final in 1981 and later became champion alongside Hamman.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Bob Hamman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bob_Hamman)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Blue Team](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blue_Team_(bridge))
- [Wikipédia (EN): Zia Mahmood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zia_Mahmood)

### Checkers (English Draughts)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/damas-inglesas-checkers
- GOAT: Marion Tinsley (US)
- Fact-check: medium

American Marion Tinsley is considered the greatest checkers (English draughts, 8×8 board) player of all time: he was world champion from 1955 to 1958 and from 1975 to 1991, never lost a title match and, from 1950 until his death in 1995, lost only seven games — two of them to the computer program Chinook, which he beat 4–2 in 1992.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Marion Tinsley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marion_Tinsley)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Campeonato Mundial de Checkers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Checkers/Draughts_Championship)

### Women’s Chess
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/xadrez-feminino
- GOAT: Judit Polgar (HU)
- Legends: Hou Yifan (CN), Maia Chiburdanidze (GE), Ju Wenjun (CN)
- Fact-check: medium

Judit Polgar is the only woman to reach the overall top 10 and beat several world champions in classical games, almost always competing against men. Hou Yifan was a four-time world champion and the youngest ever, at 16. Ju Wenjun won her fifth world title in 2025, becoming the fourth woman to win five.

Sources:
- [Chess.com — Ju Wenjun pentacampeã](https://www.chess.com/news/view/ju-wenjun-wins-5th-womens-world-chess-championship)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Ju Wenjun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ju_Wenjun)

### Men’s Chess
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/xadrez-masculino
- GOAT: Garry Kasparov (RU), Magnus Carlsen (NO)
- Legends: Bobby Fischer (US), Vladimir Kramnik (RU), Anatoly Karpov (RU)
- Other greats: Viswanathan Anand (IN)
- Prospects: Gukesh Dommaraju (IN), Javokhir Sindarov (UZ)
- Fact-check: medium

Garry Kasparov was world champion for 15 years (1985–2000), world No. 1 for almost two decades and is voted the greatest of all by expert panels. Magnus Carlsen shares the top spot: he has been world No. 1 since July 2011 — the longest reign in history — reached the highest rating ever recorded (2882), was five-time classical world champion and has 6 world rapid and 9 world blitz titles (the latest in Doha, 2025), plus winning the first Freestyle World Championship (2026). The classical title will be contested between Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov in late 2026.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Chess_Championship_2026)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Magnus Carlsen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magnus_Carlsen)
- [The Sun — 20º título mundial de Carlsen](https://thesun.my/sports/magnus-carlsen-clinches-20th-world-chess-title/)

### Chinese Chess (Xiangqi)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/xadrez-chines-xiangqi
- GOAT: Hu Ronghua (CN)
- Legends: Lü Qin (CN)
- Fact-check: medium

Hu Ronghua holds the record of 14 Chinese national xiangqi titles — ten in a row between 1960 and 1979 — and is both the youngest (15) and the oldest (55) champion. Lü Qin won five individual World Championships and was world No. 1. Wang Tianyi, No. 1 from 2014 to 2024, was banned for life in 2024 for match-fixing.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Hu Ronghua](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hu_Ronghua)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Lü Qin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C3%BC_Qin)
- [Xiangqi.com — principais torneios da China](https://www.xiangqi.com/articles/major-xiangqi-chinese-chess-tournaments-in-china-part-1)

### Classic Tetris
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/tetris-classico
- GOAT: Jonas Neubauer (US)
- Legends: Joseph Saelee (US), Michael Artiaga (US), Alex Thach (US)
- Stars: Willis “Blue Scuti” Gibson (US), Harry Hong (US), Justin “Fractal161” Yu (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Jonas Neubauer won the Classic Tetris World Championship seven times. Michael Artiaga, the youngest champion in history, won in 2020, 2021 and 2026; Alex Thach won back-to-back in 2024 and 2025.

Sources:
- [Guinness World Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/457657-most-wins-of-the-classic-tetris-world-championship)

### Dominoes
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/domino
- Legends: Joaquín Martínez (DO)
- Other greats: Miguel Torres (DO), Carlos Marquina (VE), Edilberto De La Cruz (CO)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

Dominoes has more than one world federation (FID and FEMUNDO) and there is no consensus on a GOAT. The Dominican Republic’s Joaquín Martínez is the most successful player at the World Championships, with titles in 2004, 2008 and the following years, in singles and pairs. Recent singles champions include Miguel Torres (Dominican Republic, 2022), Edilberto De La Cruz (Colombia, 2023) and Venezuela’s Carlos Marquina, champion in Salou.

Sources:
- [COLIMDO — campeões mundiais de dominó](https://colimdo.org/atletard/campeones-mundiales-de-domino/)
- [Listín Diario — Miguel Torres campeão mundial](https://listindiario.com/el-deporte/2022/10/04/741770/miguel-torres-nuevo-campeon-mundial-de-domino.html)

### Women’s Draughts
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/damas-feminino
- GOAT: Zoja Golubeva (LV)
- Legends: Tamara Tansykkuzhina (RU), Elena Altsjoel (RU), Elena Mikhailovskaya (RU)
- Stars: Darya Tkachenko (NL), Olga Levina (UA)
- Other greats: Viktoriya Motrichko (UA), Natalia Sadowska (PL)
- Fact-check: medium

Latvia’s Zoja Golubeva is the greatest champion in draughts history: she won 15 women’s world titles between 1986 and 2017, more than any player, man or woman. Russia’s Tamara Tansykkuzhina comes next, with seven titles (2001 to 2021). In the recent era, Darya Tkachenko won her fourth title in the 2024 match, and Ukraine’s Viktoriya Motrichko was champion in 2023 and 2025.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): campeãs mundiais de damas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_women%27s_Draughts_World_Championship_winners)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial feminino de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Women%27s_World_Draughts_Championship)
- [Wikipédia (EN): match feminino de 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Women%27s_World_Draughts_Championship_match)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de Damas (Golubeva e Chizhov, lendas vivas)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Draughts_Championship)

### Men’s Draughts
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/damas-masculino
- GOAT: Alexei Chizhov (RU)
- Legends: Isidore Weiss (FR), Ton Sijbrands (NL), Iser Kuperman (UA)
- Stars: Jan Groenendijk (NL), Alexander Schwarzman (RU), Alexander Georgiev (RU)
- Other greats: Yuri Anikeev (UA), Roel Boomstra (NL)
- Prospects: Jitse Slump (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Russia’s Alexei Chizhov is the greatest champion in the history of international draughts (10×10 board): he won ten World Championships, from 1988 to 2005, and in 1996 broke the record of seven titles held by France’s Isidore Weiss, which had stood for 87 years. The Netherlands’ Ton Sijbrands, champion in 1972, was his great rival. The current champion is the Netherlands’ Jan Groenendijk, who won the 2024 match against Yuri Anikeev and the 2025 World Championship in Yaoundé (Cameroon), ahead of Jitse Slump, his 2026 challenger.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Alexei Chizhov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexei_Chizhov)
- [Wikipédia (EN): campeões mundiais de damas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Draughts_World_Championship_winners)
- [Wikipédia (EN): match do Mundial de 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_World_Draughts_Championship_match)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Mundial de 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_World_Draughts_Championship)
- [AIMS — o Mundial de 2025 em Iaundé](https://aims.sport/one-board-one-dream-the-olympic-spirit-of-the-2025-world-draughts-championship-in-yaounde/2025/)

### Go (Baduk or Weiqi)
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/go-baduk-ou-weiqi
- GOAT: Lee Chang-ho (KR), Go Seigen (CN/JP)
- Legends: Lee Sedol (KR), Cho Hunhyun (KR), Shin Jin-seo (KR)
- Stars: Ke Jie (CN), Honinbo Shusaku (JP)
- Other greats: Gu Li (CN), Cho Chikun (KR)
- Fact-check: medium

Lee Chang-ho was world No. 1 from 1991 to 2006 and holds the record for international titles. Go Seigen is seen by many as the greatest genius of the game in the 20th century. Lee Sedol became famous for his match against AlphaGo (2016). Shin Jin-seo, with nine major international titles, has been Korea’s No. 1 for more than six straight years and is the biggest name of the current era.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lee_Chang-ho)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lee_Sedol)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Shin Jin-seo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shin_Jin-seo)

### Poker
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/poker
- GOAT: Phil Ivey (US), Phil Hellmuth (US)
- Legends: Daniel Negreanu (CA), Stu Ungar (US), Johnny Moss (US)
- Stars: Michael Mizrachi (US), Doyle Brunson (US), Johnny Chan (US), Jeremy Ausmus (US), Erik Seidel (US)
- Other greats: Isaac Haxton (US), Justin Bonomo (US), Bryn Kenney (US), Stephen Chidwick (GB), John Hennigan (US), Men Nguyen (VN/US), Billy Baxter (US), David Peters (US), Mikita Bodyakovsky (BY), Jim Bechtel (US), Antonio Esfandiari (US)
- Fact-check: high

Phil Ivey is considered by many the GOAT of poker, especially in tournaments and high-stakes cash games: he has 11 World Series of Poker (WSOP) bracelets, seven of them outside Texas Hold’em, and is revered for his cool, versatile game. Phil Hellmuth holds the record of 17 WSOP bracelets, the most of all time, and is the benchmark for tournament longevity.

Sources:

### Rummikub
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/rummikub
- Legends: Masato Kuwabara (JP)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

The World Rummikub Championship has been held every three years since 1991 and brings together national champions from more than 30 countries. There is no clear GOAT: Japan’s Masato Kuwabara is the only two-time world champion, and Japan is the country with the most titles. The 11th edition was held in Gdańsk, Poland, in 2024.

Sources:
- [Rummikub — Mundial de Gdańsk 2024](https://rummikub.com/wrc11-gdansk-poland-2024/)
- [NamuWiki — Campeonato Mundial de Rummikub](https://en.namu.wiki/w/%EC%9B%94%EB%93%9C%20%EB%A3%A8%EB%AF%B8%ED%81%90%EB%B8%8C%20%EC%B1%94%ED%94%BC%EC%96%B8%EC%8B%AD)
- [Focus Taiwan — vice-campeão mundial em 2024](https://focustaiwan.tw/culture/202409110015)

### Scrabble
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/scrabble
- GOAT: Nigel Richards (NZ)
- Legends: Adam Logan (CA)
- Other greats: Benjamín Olaizola (AR)
- Fact-check: medium

Nigel Richards is the most successful English-language world champion in history and won the French (2015 and 2018) and Spanish (2024) World Championships without speaking either language. In the 2025 World Championship final he lost to Canada’s Adam Logan, who won his second title.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): World Scrabble Championship 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Scrabble_Championship_2025)
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigel_Richards)

### Shogi
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/shogi
- GOAT: Yoshiharu Habu (JP)
- Legends: Sōta Fujii (JP), Yasuharu Ōyama (JP)
- Fact-check: medium

Yoshiharu Habu holds the record of 99 major titles in shogi, Japanese chess; he was the first to hold all seven traditional titles at once (1996) and the first to earn all seven lifetime titles (2017), according to Guinness. Sōta Fujii became in 2023 the first to hold all eight major titles simultaneously and keeps piling up precocity records.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Yoshiharu Habu](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoshiharu_Habu)
- [Guinness World Records — sete títulos vitalícios de Habu](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/504434-first-shogi-player-to-win-the-seven-major-lifetime-titles-traditional-titles)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Sōta Fujii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C5%8Dta_Fujii)

### Speedcubing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/speedcubing
- GOAT: Feliks Zemdegs (AU)
- Legends: Max Park (US)
- Stars: Yiheng Wang (CN), Tymon Kolasiński (PL), Erik Akkersdijk (NL)
- Fact-check: medium

Feliks Zemdegs broke more than 120 world records and won two 3×3 World Championships, and is considered the greatest speedcuber in history. Max Park shares the record for world titles. Yiheng Wang was 3×3 world champion in 2025 and holds the current records in the event.

Sources:
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Feliks_Zemdegs)
- [Wikipédia (EN): Yiheng Wang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yiheng_Wang)
- [Guinness World Records](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2025/3/speed-cubing-legends-max-park-and-feliks-zemdegs-race-each-other-in-wholesome-showdown)

### Typing
Page: https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/#m/digitacao
- GOAT: Sean Wrona (US)
- Legends: Anthony “Chak” Ermolin (US)
- Fact-check: low

Sean Wrona won the first Ultimate Typing Championship (2010), at 163 words per minute in the main round, and has around 20 competitive typing titles, including several at Intersteno, the world championship of text production. In the 2020 edition he lost the final to Anthony “Chak” Ermolin, who reached 210 words per minute.

Sources:
- [Wikipédia (EN): Ultimate Typing Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_Typing_Championship)
- [Das Keyboard — Wrona campeão em 2010](https://www.daskeyboard.com/blog/the-fastest-typist-in-the-world-wins-the-ultimate-typing-championship)
- [JCR — vencedores do concurso de teclado do Intersteno](https://www.thejcr.com/2016/07/05/ncras-intersteno-task-force-interviews-the-winners-of-the-intersteno-internet-keyboarding-contest/)

- Legends: Miguel “Blinkzr” Quilestook (US)
- GOAT: no consensus yet
- Fact-check: low

No consensus: the Apex Legends world championship (ALGS Championship) has had a different winner every year. In 2026, Oblivion became the first team from the last-chance qualifier to win the title, with Blinkzr as MVP.

### Brawl Stars

- GOAT: Tensai (JP)
- Stars: Achapi (JP)
- Fact-check: low

Japan’s Tensai is the most successful Brawl Stars champion, with three world titles (2021 and 2022 with ZETA DIVISION and 2025 with Crazy Raccoon). Japan dominates the scene, with four of the seven world championships held.

### Call of Duty

- Legends: Seth “Scump” Abner (US)
- Stars: Damon “Karma” Barlow (CA), Chris “Simp” Lehr (US), Anthony “Shotzzy” Cuevas-Castro (US)
- Other greats: James “Clayster” Eubanks (US)
- Fact-check: medium

Crimsix has three world titles and around 38 major championships, the most in Call of Duty history — Scump himself recognizes him as the greatest of all.
